roles.label: The Player (male)
roles.who: A young man, 17 to 22. The owner records this one.
roles.characters: The student you play, when the player picks a male character.
roles.sound: A fresher who grows up over five years: lively, cheeky, kind. Short shouts should sound called-out, not read. Use your own natural voice and your normal Nigerian English. Speak Pidgin, Hausa, Yoruba or Igbo exactly where it is written. Do not put on a voice or an accent.

scenes.title: Mission 0: Opening: arriving
scenes.context: Your family's car brings you through the Main Gate on registration morning. Your parents help with the bags, the porter takes them to your room, you meet your roommate, and then they have to go.

lines.text: Mum, why is the pot in my suitcase?
I will. Go before Mum cries.
…Okay. I'm a student now.

scenes.title: Mission 1: Welcome, fresher
scenes.context: Registration day. You arrive with one bag, one admission letter and a mother's list of instructions.

lines.text: Mum's list. "Pray. Read. Eat. Don't follow bad friends."
Bring back the Tupperware.
Why not?
We did it. We're students.

scenes.title: Mission 2: Belle first
scenes.context: Day one of real life: eat, go to class, survive, come home. Simple.

lines.text: Yesterday it was ₦250.
This bread is soft. Why is this bread so soft?
My money. Where's my money?
Later. Hand me the salt.
My little sister counts my shirts when I pack. She said I owe her two.

scenes.title: Mission 3: Two wheels
scenes.context: The campus is big and your legs are small. Emeka at the gate has a bicycle that needs a rider and a box of books that needs to reach the Library before Mrs.

lines.text: I can ride. I've ridden. Once. In secondary school. Into a wall.
This bicycle?
Thank you! Who are you?
Not anonymous?

scenes.title: Mission 4: They have taken light
scenes.context: The power goes off. Everyone shouts "Ah, they have taken light!" like every night.

lines.text: Light?
Found it. It's pink. It says "Mummy's Boy" on the side.

scenes.title: Mission 5: The missing fuse
scenes.context: Dr. Okonkwo says the blackouts aren't Works Department laziness: a fuse is missing from the campus feeder.

lines.text: How did you know?
The fuse.
How do you know?

scenes.title: Mission 6: Mai Shayi knows
scenes.context: Mai Shayi Audu knows every rumour on campus and sells it with tea. He says the shades gather in the Sculpture Garden.

lines.text: Who are you?
Why not on the bench?
…Which?

scenes.title: Mission 7: Fresher tax
scenes.context: At the court, a big boy who calls himself "Big Sly" is charging freshers ₦500 to walk past it. Today, he wants yours.

lines.text: It's not tax. It's robbery wearing a jersey.
…Fine. Here.

scenes.title: Mission 8: Run am
scenes.context: Word of the court has gone round. Jega, the hall football captain, wants to see if the fresher who blocked Big Sly's boys can also ride.

lines.text: What's her name?
You don't know?

scenes.title: Mission 9: Sly's last stand
scenes.context: Bolaji has heard about the race. He doesn't like freshers who are talked about more than he is.

lines.text: You like him.

scenes.title: Mission 10: Stone that points
scenes.context: Light mission, a Saturday walk. Kelechi, the sculpture student a year ahead, says three of the statues point.

lines.text: This key.

scenes.title: Mission 11: Baba Dam
scenes.context: The pier is rotten in three places. Baba Dam, the old fisherman, can't fix it alone.

lines.text: Cement.
Where is she now?

scenes.title: Mission 13: Keke Grand Prix
scenes.context: The Ring Road Grand Prix: twelve kekes, one lap of the whole campus, a trophy made of an old exhaust pipe sprayed gold. Half the campus is watching.

lines.text: Somebody hold this! I'm helping!
Sorry! I'll come back! Spiritually!

scenes.title: Mission 14: The dam at midnight
scenes.context: Baba Dam's nets come up torn every night, and something under the water hums when the lights go out. He wants to see it.

lines.text: …For the water.

scenes.title: Mission 15: The class of your life
scenes.context: Dr. Okonkwo takes the relay core, goes quiet, then gives you a choice: she'll explain what it is — after you score four out of five in her test.

lines.text: The man in the lab coat.
lines.scene: Mission 15: The class of your life

lines.text: Lucky guess.
lines.scene: Mission 15: The class of your life

scenes.title: Mission 16: Gather the crew
scenes.context: The Maker says the shades will gather at the Senate on the night of the next blackout, and that one person with a torch is a snack. Five people with torches is a problem for them.

lines.text: They were ₦300 yesterday!

scenes.title: Mission 18: Wings
scenes.context: Captain Uche has watched freshers dance at the Senate on her phone. She says anybody who can make a campus dance can learn to make a plane climb.

lines.text: It's so small.
What?

scenes.title: Mission 19: Up NEPA party
scenes.context: The light has stayed on for a whole week. DJ Kabiru says that deserves noise, and he needs a crowd, a snack table and somebody brave enough to dance first.

lines.text: Do you want to dance?
NEPA.

scenes.title: Mission 20: Profile picture
scenes.context: Lyzzy says your profile picture is "a crime against your face". She will fix it, if you pose at four gardens before the light goes.

lines.text: The light was bad.

scenes.title: Mission 21: Express delivery
scenes.context: Emeka the okada rider has sprained his wrist on the busiest morning of the month. Four deliveries, his bike, your backpack, and his phone ringing the whole time.

lines.text: Your garri is already in my bag.

scenes.title: Mission 23: The hum
scenes.context: The Maker says the ground has started humming. He wants you to listen with him, at night, when the campus is quiet enough to hear what is under it.

lines.text: The coil?
You're standing very still.

scenes.title: Mission 24: Two papers, one day
scenes.context: Physics test at nine. Mathematics test at nine.

lines.text: You don't have a pen?
You're good at maths.

scenes.title: Mission 25: Paper trail
scenes.context: Mai Shayi has noticed a man in a good suit who visits the Bank after closing, every time the light goes. He would like to know why.

lines.text: You don't wear contact lenses.

scenes.title: Mission 26: East Side Drift
scenes.context: The East Side Drift is a car race round the tightest corners on campus. Kelechi lost it last year to a senior who "drove like a poem".

lines.text: I'm just turning—

scenes.title: Mission 28: Wingman
scenes.context: Sadiq likes Joy, the radio intern. Sadiq has never said more than "Toh" to her.

lines.text: I'm just… listening.

scenes.title: Mission 29: Night market
scenes.context: With the Maker gone four days and the market dark at night, a gang of older boys calling themselves "the levy" are going stall to stall, collecting a "light fee" for lamps that don't exist.

lines.text: You do make the rules. It's your shop.

scenes.title: Mission 30: Signal from the sky
scenes.context: Captain Uche wants a dusk flight "for the joy of it", a loop over the campus at the golden hour. Bring a camera.

lines.text: Where were you?
Yes.

scenes.title: Mission 31: The second eel
scenes.context: The thing in the water that pulled Baba Dam's net is a mother eel, very old and very large. Since the Maker's absence, the shades have been gathering on her, and she is lashing at

lines.text: Why?
Who?

scenes.title: Mission 32: Six plaques
scenes.context: The Maker has the dynamo. To use it he needs three more things: a perfect answer, copper winding and a spark gap.

lines.text: I don't know.

scenes.title: Mission 33: School Marathon
scenes.context: The School Marathon is the whole campus on foot. Coach Danladi's prize this year is a generator, donated by the traders.

lines.text: You again. Thank you. Who are you?
There was a boy. White shirt.

scenes.title: Mission 34: Everybody
scenes.context: The Maker has a generator, a dynamo and a coil that hums. He says that on convocation night, when the seniors graduate and the whole campus lights up, the dark will come for the light.

lines.text: Everybody who?

scenes.title: Mission 35: Blackout protocol
scenes.context: Three nights before convocation, the whole grid fails. Sgt.

lines.text: Stay inside! It's fine! Mostly!

scenes.title: Mission 36: Convocation night
scenes.context: Convocation night. The seniors graduate; every light on campus goes on at once; and Count Entropy, fully grown on a year of the school's fear, stands on the Senate steps.

lines.text: Then we find the other five.
Not for long.

scenes.title: Mission 37: Stalite
scenes.context: You come back from the break and somebody else's name is on your bed. Sort it out before dark, and find out what "stalite" means.

lines.text: It's for the room. Half of it. Maybe a quarter.

scenes.title: Mission 41: The mall never blinks
scenes.context: The whole campus goes dark at once. Across the road the mall is glowing like a ship.

lines.text: It's the same hum. From the garden.

scenes.title: Mission 44: Iron Mama hums
scenes.context: The Maker has listened to the ground for a year. He sends you where he cannot go: under the mall, after closing, to see what is making the hum.

lines.text: Where were you last week?

scenes.title: Mission 58: Three hundred
scenes.context: Third year. The notice board puts you in a project group of four: two serious, one asleep in Pepsi Garden, one not seen since Tuesday.

lines.text: No.

scenes.title: Mission 77: Wedding at the quarters
scenes.context: Malam Garba's daughter is marrying. You need an outfit, a gift and a place in the dance line.

lines.text: Eat before registration.

scenes.title: Mission 100: Finalist
scenes.context: Mission one hundred. Freshers call you "senior" and step off the path.

lines.text: It's yours. Look after the window; it sticks.

scenes.title: Mission 111: Project defence
scenes.context: The last test. Then you, a rebuilt coil under a cloth, and a panel that has failed better students.

lines.text: Because I didn't build the second one. Twelve departments did.

scenes.title: Mission 38: Grand opening
scenes.context: The market is now a mall. Hajiya Ladi's goods are at the gate, her new shop is upstairs, and the only escalator goes up.

lines.text: It was ₦250 at the gate.

scenes.title: Mission 39: New drip
scenes.context: Alhaji Needle will sew your first native. It will be ready Thursday.

scenes.title: Mission 40: Level two, round one
scenes.context: Basit holds every high score in the Game Room. He lets you pick the machine.

scenes.context: The whole campus goes dark at once. Across the road the mall is glowing like a ship.

scenes.title: Mission 42: Meter reader
scenes.context: Every evening, just before the campus goes dark, a Works van leaves the substation and drives to the mall. Follow it without being seen.

lines.text: Two. Two of what?

What story?

scenes.title: Mission 43: Department week
scenes.context: Your first department week: a quiz against the department next door, a five-a-side, and a dinner with a dress code and a speech.

lines.text: I'm still asking.

scenes.title: Mission 44: Iron Mama hums
scenes.context: The Maker has listened to the ground for a year. He sends you where he cannot go: under the mall, after closing, to see what is making the hum.

scenes.title: Mission 45: Shuttle strike
scenes.context: The shuttle drivers have parked over unpaid allowances. Phase 2 is four kilometres away and full of stranded students.

lines.text: I'm not laughing.

scenes.title: Mission 47: Test week
scenes.context: Three tests in two days, Ada's night tutorial under the one working lamp, a summons from the HOD you were not expecting, and then first-semester exams in NELT.

lines.text: Who told you that?
Somebody wrote about me.
Did you?

scenes.title: Mission 48: Flying lesson two
scenes.context: Captain Uche wants your turns tidier. You want a photograph of the mall roof.

lines.text: Strawberries. From up here they look like a mistake.
You already had a picture.
What fish pond?

scenes.title: Mission 49: Chief Megawatt
scenes.context: The mall's owner invites you up. He would like to sponsor your department.

lines.text: And for everyone else?
Of what?
KB? The shop guy?
Your client is you.

scenes.title: Mission 50: Bolaji's board
scenes.context: A skate contest in the mall car park. Bolaji, all six feet of him, needs a spotter, somebody to film, and somebody to believe it.

lines.text: You want him to call you Abbas.

scenes.title: Mission 51: Change-Over
scenes.context: You know the driver's name now. He sees you coming and runs, through the market, on an okada.

lines.text: Six months. He's been counting.
Yeah.

scenes.title: Mission 52: Phase 2 goes dark
scenes.context: While the feeder is argued over, Phase 2 has had no light for a week. Water, torches and charged phones go out in convoy on the long road at night.

lines.text: Khalid, you'll fall.
Tell me later. When there's light.
I saw.

scenes.title: Mission 53: The second coil
scenes.context: The Maker reads the second plaque aloud. The coil under the mall needs three parts.

lines.text: Do they?
Where's the kaftan?

scenes.title: Mission 54: Love in the time of NEPA
scenes.context: A plan for the evening. Then no light, and no money either.

lines.text: your fear of the dark / your mother's cooking / the Maker's fish drawing.

scenes.title: Mission 56: Light for everybody
scenes.context: The feeder must be switched back at three corners of campus, ninety seconds apart. Then a panel in the Senate asks what you saw, and reads your own choices back to you.

lines.text: It's everybody's.
Baba Shuttle heard "next week" since May.
He had nowhere.

scenes.title: Mission 57: Sign-out, small
scenes.context: Second-semester exams in steady light. Then the final-years sign out in white shirts, and you hold the markers.

lines.text: Y.B. Again.
Which department are you, Muhammad?

scenes.title: Mission 58: Three hundred
scenes.context: Third year. The notice board puts you in a project group of four: two serious, one asleep in Pepsi Garden, one not seen since Tuesday.

lines.text: Hi, IDK.

scenes.title: Mission 59: Indefinite
scenes.context: A sheet of paper on the Senate door. A congress at Theatre CD.

lines.text: He'll call.
Will the farm be okay?

scenes.title: Mission 60: Those who stayed
scenes.context: Count who is left: a tea seller, a nurse, a porter, a man with a coil, and you. No allowance is coming.

lines.text: It is Wednesday.

scenes.title: Mission 61: Small Sadiq
scenes.context: A boy at Demonstration school wants to be an engineer "like you". This time you ask the questions, and choose how to explain when he gets one wrong.

lines.text: I'll show you.
Not really.
Your uncle showed you my notes?
He's not a ghost. He drinks tea.
You're not on strike?
Good, actually.

scenes.title: Mission 62: Past the last streetlight
scenes.context: With nothing to do you walk past the fence. Trees, then more trees.

lines.text: Somebody already argued with this sign.
One stayed?
She gave me two cones of groundnut.

scenes.title: Mission 63: Empty halls
scenes.context: Something is sitting in Kainji Theatre. Row after row of it.

lines.text: There are too many. And it's so quiet.
Who wrote that?
That's not even a joke.
…That was his coat. Wasn't it?
That's not the jingle.

scenes.title: Mission 64: The sit-down
scenes.context: Your roommate has not left the room in four days. Not ill.

lines.text: It's swollen to the ceiling.
I had one ready.

scenes.title: Mission 65: Patrol games
scenes.context: Kaka said follow the white stones. There are a great many white stones.

lines.text: He hums Kabiru's jingle. Off key.
Six. Always six.
I saw it. A school. Behind the hills. Six chimneys.
You've never been quiet in your life.
Somebody's walked this before. Many times.
Thank you.

scenes.title: Mission 66: Old Campus
scenes.context: Walls with trees growing through them. A plaque with the same marks as Kelechi's statues.

lines.text: Kelechi's stones. They were pointing here the whole time.
Someone's been here. Recently.
That's him. That laugh is the Maker.
Not anymore.
The machine eats yams?

scenes.title: Mission 67: The Maker's secret
scenes.context: You play him the last tape. He hears his own name, and for the first time since you met him, he sits down.

lines.text: Is she alive?
That you're brave.

scenes.title: Mission 68: Night nurse
scenes.context: The Sick Bay generator is on its last cup. Fetch four jerrycans, driving as if eggs were in the back.

lines.text: …and the goat you named after your father is fat now. He is well. Be well.
Yes, no, yes.

scenes.title: Mission 71: Bolaji's choice
scenes.context: The mall wants Bolaji skating in its adverts full-time. He has a withdrawal form half filled in.

lines.text: Love.

scenes.title: Mission 73: Test run
scenes.context: The first lamp goes up at dusk on the darkest bend. It comes on.

lines.text: KB knew.
It's everybody's lamp.

scenes.title: Mission 74: Ranger Lawal's debt
scenes.context: A patrol has not come back. He has turned you round three times.

lines.text: The owl's still here.
The forest's student.

scenes.title: Mission 75: The third coil wakes
scenes.context: Old Campus has no power. Your project lamps do.

lines.text: That's the kaftan from the MIB Store.
Hills don't move.

scenes.title: Mission 76: Heartbreak, or not
scenes.context: After months apart, somebody is not where they used to be. Listen first.

lines.text: That doesn't make sense.

scenes.title: Mission 79: IT letter
scenes.context: One letter, four stamps, three offices, two "come back tomorrow"s and a bank queue. Then a choice of where you train for six months.

lines.text: KB, is that a warning?

scenes.title: Mission 82: The collab
scenes.context: Lucky wants three stunts for one video: a wheelie down the boulevard, a wave from the Senate steps, a keke full of goats. Then you go to buy socks and forty people want a picture.

lines.text: How did you hear?

scenes.title: Mission 84: Workplace accident
scenes.context: A colleague is down. Stop the bleeding, keep them talking, drive to the Sick Bay gently.

lines.text: You will tell her yourself. Keep talking.

scenes.title: Mission 87: Night flight (Heist 3: the old control tower)
scenes.context: The old control tower has been locked since before Captain Uche. The fourth plaque is inside, the stairs are full of Echoes, and the beacon must be lined up from the air on three passes.

lines.text: You know this tower.

scenes.title: Mission 88: Fashion show
scenes.context: Alhaji Needle's collection on a runway through the mall. He needs a model who can walk and turn.

lines.text: They'll look. And this time they'll listen.

scenes.title: Mission 90: Touch grass
scenes.context: Baba Dam does not own a phone. He owns a boat and a great deal of patience.

lines.text: The Maker has a sister?

scenes.title: Mission 94: Election day
scenes.context: Comrade Sadiya is running again and Yakubu is her manager. Posters, a debate card that says "second speaker", and a ballot box that turns out to be under the returning officer's chair.

lines.text: You wrote it, didn't you?

scenes.title: Mission 96: The Mirror
scenes.context: A copy of you as tall as the FSLG letters, made of every clip ever filmed of you. Hit it and it hits back.

lines.text: Bature, I never thanked you for every garri you stole. Thank you.

scenes.title: Mission 97: Log off
scenes.context: What do you do with being known? Then a logbook on a table and a panel in a row: the industrial-training defence.

lines.text: I'll buy the garri this semester.

scenes.title: Mission 98: Sadiq's surprise
scenes.context: You owe your roommate an apology for most of this year. Before you can give it, the whole room shouts "surprise".

lines.text: I was a bad friend this year. No. I've been busy. No. I'm sorry. Just that.

scenes.title: Mission 105: Parts from everywhere
scenes.context: Six people each have one thing the coil needs. Each asks one small thing in return.

lines.text: Sheikh Biru.

scenes.title: Mission 111: Project defence
scenes.context: The last test. Then you, a rebuilt coil under a cloth, and a panel that has failed better students.

roles.label: The Player (female)
roles.characters: The student you play, when the player picks a female character.
roles.sound: A fresher who grows up over five years: lively, cheeky, kind. Short shouts should sound called-out, not read. Use your own natural voice and your normal Nigerian English. Speak Pidgin, Hausa, Yoruba or Igbo exactly where it is written. Do not put on a voice or an accent.

roles.label: Bature (male roommate)
roles.who: A young man, 18 to 22, the funniest voice you know.
roles.characters: Bature, Bature (your roommate), Dream Bature, Your best friend
roles.sound: Bature is the default roommate and the companion on most missions: a joker, loyal, always eating your garri. Warm and quick. Use your own natural voice and your normal Nigerian English. Speak Pidgin, Hausa, Yoruba or Igbo exactly where it is written. Do not put on a voice or an accent.

scenes.title: Mission 1: Welcome, fresher
scenes.context: Registration day. You arrive with one bag, one admission letter and a mother's list of instructions.

lines.text: Riddle me this: what has two beds, one fan and three bags of garri?
This room. Two of the bags are mine. The third one is also mine. Welcome!
I'm Bature. Some people say Berti. Those people are wrong but I allow it.
Now we're roommates. That means your problem is my problem. Within reason.
Within reason means not garri. Garri problems are separate.
What's the last line?
Garba won't touch a file without the Sick Bay stamp. The whole queue learns it late.
What is African eight?
We are students with no lunch. Let's not celebrate on an empty stomach.

scenes.title: Mission 2: Belle first
scenes.context: Day one of real life: eat, go to class, survive, come home. Simple.

lines.text: KB, riddle me this: what gets more expensive the happier you look?
Garri is not food. It's a lifestyle with water.
KB adds kindness. And something else. Don't ask what.
Check the hole in your bag. …Okay, it's a very honest hole. Everything fell out.
Riddle me this: what has a mouth and eats your money? Your bag.
You're cooking? You? Should I call the Fire Station now or later?
Tell me one thing about home.
Then she'll be here by Friday. Hide the shirts.
Riddle me this: what goes up and down but never moves? Our fan. Night.

scenes.title: Mission 3: Two wheels
scenes.context: The campus is big and your legs are small. Emeka at the gate has a bicycle that needs a rider and a box of books that needs to reach the Library before Mrs.

lines.text: Riddle me this: what has two wheels, one rider and zero brakes?
This bicycle. Go slowly near the fountain. The fountain is undefeated.
She said "shh" at the end. Is that a word or a warning?

scenes.title: Mission 4: They have taken light
scenes.context: The power goes off. Everyone shouts "Ah, they have taken light!" like every night.

lines.text: Riddle me this: what goes off every night and comes back like nothing happened?
My cousin's boyfriend. But also light. Watch. Three, two…
Torch. Where's your torch? Your mother packed you a torch. Mothers always do.
It's a torch. It works. Nobody can read in the dark.
Did you feel that? The air went the wrong way.
I'm holding the torch! I'm being brave! Mostly my hand is being brave!
Tell me you saw them. Please tell me you saw them and it wasn't the beans.
Malam, riddle me this: who knows a thing and says "hm" instead?
Free tea? Riddle me this: what's rarer than light in this school?

scenes.title: Mission 5: The missing fuse
scenes.context: Dr. Okonkwo says the blackouts aren't Works Department laziness: a fuse is missing from the campus feeder.

lines.text: Riddle me this: what is small, burnt and the reason nobody can charge their phone?
Correct. Also me, if we're being honest. I unplugged three phones to charge mine.

scenes.title: Mission 6: Mai Shayi knows
scenes.context: Mai Shayi Audu knows every rumour on campus and sells it with tea. He says the shades gather in the Sculpture Garden.

lines.text: Riddle me this: what is hot, sweet and cheaper than friendship?
Riddle me this, shade: what has no face and no manners? You! Ha! It worked!
It worked once. Don't expect a sequel. Hit them!
Riddle me this, old man: what speaks in riddles and never answers?

scenes.context: At the court, a big boy who calls himself "Big Sly" is charging freshers ₦500 to walk past it. Today, he wants yours.

lines.text: Riddle me this: what has no constitution but collects tax? A thief with a ball.
Riddle me this: who is smaller than a fist and stronger than Big Sly?
That girl. Remember her. Bow when you see her.

scenes.title: Mission 8: Run am
scenes.context: Word of the court has gone round. Jega, the hall football captain, wants to see if the fresher who blocked Big Sly's boys can also ride.

lines.text: Riddle me this: what goes round and round and comes back tired? You! Go!
This is the best show on campus and it's free. Don't tell KB. He'll charge.

lines.text: Riddle me this: what's big, angry and asks for honour? A man who lost his tax income.

lines.text: Riddle me this: what opens nothing and makes everybody curious?

scenes.context: Convocation night. The seniors graduate; every light on campus goes on at once; and Count Entropy, fully grown on a year of the school's fear, stands on the Senate steps.

roles.label: Young men A
roles.characters: Sadiq, Muktar, Khalid, Yusuf, Shamsu, Micheal, Mubarak, Musa, Musa B.
roles.sound: Course mates and roommate options. Sadiq quiet, Muktar a born chairman, Yusuf charming, Khalid steady, Shamsu the brilliant, devout one who explains everything (“Professor Shamsu”). Change your manner, not your voice. Use your own natural voice and your normal Nigerian English. Speak Pidgin, Hausa, Yoruba or Igbo exactly where it is written. Do not put on a voice or an accent.

roles.sound: Abbas the student mechanic, Kelechi the sculptor, Tunde the quiet artist, Lula the gentle listener. Easy and friendly. Use your own natural voice and your normal Nigerian English. Speak Pidgin, Hausa, Yoruba or Igbo exactly where it is written. Do not put on a voice or an accent.

lines.text: That fan has clicked since I was a student. You've stolen my lullaby.
Fruit is medicine. Letters are stronger medicine. Fans are… fans.
No running on the… oh, it's Jega's socks. Run. Run faster.
Sand, cement, water, patience. Today we have all four.
My father drew this tower. He never finished it. Neither will I. Yet.
Wood comes from the forest edge. Ranger Lawal says no more this year. So.
Bature at the front? Are we together? …We are. Finally.

roles.label: Campus staff and security (male)
roles.who: A man who can sound 30 to 60.
roles.characters: Malam Garba, Ranger Lawal, Coach Danladi, Corporal Peter, Chief Megawatt, Baba Porter, Danladi, Engr. Aliyu, Baba Shuttle, Mr. Clement, Your boss, Dad, Peter, A Ranger, Foreman Danjuma, Mr. Linus, Foreman Ikenna, Guard and others
roles.sound: Porters, the bursary, the coaches, the works engineer, the shuttle driver, and the guards and forest rangers. Each a little different, still your own voice. Guard shouts should really be shouted. Use your own natural voice and your normal Nigerian English. Speak Pidgin, Hausa, Yoruba or Igbo exactly where it is written. Do not put on a voice or an accent.

scenes.title: Mission 0: Opening: arriving
scenes.context: Your family's car brings you through the Main Gate on registration morning. Your parents help with the bags, the porter takes them to your room, you meet your roommate, and then they have to go.

lines.text: There it is. The gate. I drove through this same gate thirty years ago.
Welcome, welcome. Give me that. Your mother packed this? I can tell.
Come. Choose your room before the queue of mothers eats us.
Room delivered. Bags delivered. Child delivered. My work is finished.
Don't follow bad friends. Follow good ones. Lead some.
Bye! Bring back the Tupperware!

scenes.title: Mission 1: Welcome, fresher
scenes.context: Registration day. You arrive with one bag, one admission letter and a mother's list of instructions.

lines.text: Admission letter? Ehen. Welcome. Don't run. Don't fight. Don't fall in love.
Two out of three is fine. Porter's lodge is that way.
Name? …Hm. Your name is long. Your bag is longer. Who packed it?
I have rooms. Some have fans. Some have friends. Choose.
Choose fast. Behind you is a queue of mothers.
You want God to choose? Okay. God has chosen. Don't complain to me.
A stamp. Somebody told you. Good. Here. Your file.
Your department's desk closes at twelve. It is eleven fifty-one. Why are you still here?
Guard it like a goat guards its last leaf. Next!

scenes.title: Mission 4: They have taken light
scenes.context: The power goes off. Everyone shouts "Ah, they have taken light!" like every night.

lines.text: Shades. Hm.
The old students called them that. I thought they had stopped coming.
Go to bed. Keep your torch. Tomorrow, ask the electrical people about fuses.
A porter who wants to sleep. Goodnight.

scenes.title: Mission 8: Run am
scenes.context: Word of the court has gone round. Jega, the hall football captain, wants to see if the fresher who blocked Big Sly's boys can also ride.

lines.text: Bicycle? Ehn. Bicycles are the beginning. Everybody starts on two wheels.
Rule one: don't cry. Rule two: don't hit the goat. Rule three: see rule one.
Restart from the theatre! Everybody! Hassan, stop crying!

scenes.title: Mission 12: Licence
scenes.context: Coach Danladi says real campus life is on three wheels. Get your keke licence by winning the Hostel Run — with two passengers in the back who will not stop talking.

lines.text: Keke! The king of the road! The road disagrees, but the keke doesn't listen.
Hostel Run. With passengers. Real ones. They'll complain. That's real life.
Licence? No licence? Then this is a race without a licence. That's a crime.
Small crime. Medium crime if you argue.
…How do you know my wife's birthday?
Go. Go! And somebody buy a card for me. I'll pay. Spiritually.
You stopped at the gate and still finished. That's driving in Nigeria. Licence!

scenes.title: Mission 13: Keke Grand Prix
scenes.context: The Ring Road Grand Prix: twelve kekes, one lap of the whole campus, a trophy made of an old exhaust pipe sprayed gold. Half the campus is watching.

lines.text: I entered you. Don't thank me. Thank me after. If you lose, I never knew you.
Your keke is number seven. Seven is lucky. Number seven's wheel is not.
Seven! Lucky seven! I always knew you! I raised you!
You stopped for a rival. That is a racer. Also a loser. Both.

scenes.title: Mission 14: The dam at midnight
scenes.context: Baba Dam's nets come up torn every night, and something under the water hums when the lights go out. He wants to see it.

lines.text: Go back. Students don't come here at night.
…Ranger Lawal is on duty. Ranger Lawal has no sense of humour on duty.
Fine. Five minutes. If anything comes out of the water, run that way. Not this way.
What did you — is that from the old station? Don't touch it.
lines.tone: Ranger Lawal: arriving at a run

lines.text: …You've already touched it. Of course you have.
You did well. Don't tell anyone I said it. Ranger Lawal has a reputation.
As a man who says "go back". Go back. Goodnight.

scenes.title: Mission 17: Count Entropy
scenes.context: The blackout comes on Thursday, as the Maker said. The shades pour across the boulevard to the Senate.

lines.text: I'm not dancing. I'm checking the steps. With my feet. Rhythmically.

scenes.title: Mission 22: Senate Sprint
scenes.context: The Senate Sprint is one lap of the Senate and back, the shortest race on campus and the dirtiest. Coach Danladi enters you.

lines.text: One lap. Senate and back. Shortest race, longest arguments.
You. You have legs and no sense. That is how champions start.
Legs, sense, and a friend who came back. Three. Rare.
You lost to a man on a plank. Come back Thursday. Bring sense.
The fountain is a roundabout, not a shortcut. Remember that. Everybody forgets.

scenes.title: Mission 25: Paper trail
scenes.context: Mai Shayi has noticed a man in a good suit who visits the Bank after closing, every time the light goes. He would like to know why.

lines.text: I'm not sleeping. I'm observing with my eyes closed.

scenes.title: Mission 26: East Side Drift
scenes.context: The East Side Drift is a car race round the tightest corners on campus. Kelechi lost it last year to a senior who "drove like a poem".

lines.text: A fresher? In my club car? Before the rains? No.
I look like someone who says no.
…One race. One. If it comes back scratched, you come back scratched.
Rain! Slow down! Nobody slows down! Why do I bother?
The rains are coming. When the rains come, the road becomes soap.
You again. Go back.
Go back. Past this fence is bush. The bush doesn't care that you're fast.
I'm not a tour guide.
…That one is an iroko. Go back.

scenes.title: Mission 32: Six plaques
scenes.context: The Maker has the dynamo. To use it he needs three more things: a perfect answer, copper winding and a spark gap.

lines.text: Off before you touch. Always off. Even in a skip. Especially in a skip.

scenes.title: Mission 33: School Marathon
scenes.context: The School Marathon is the whole campus on foot. Coach Danladi's prize this year is a generator, donated by the traders.

lines.text: Whole campus. On foot. No bicycles, no okadas, no skateboards. Bolaji.
Whole campus, on foot. The generator is yours. Don't sell it.
Second. Third. Fifth. You still finished. Here: Hajiya says take it anyway.

scenes.title: Mission 34: Everybody
scenes.context: The Maker has a generator, a dynamo and a coil that hums. He says that on convocation night, when the seniors graduate and the whole campus lights up, the dark will come for the light.

lines.text: No. The Senate is not a stage. This is a convocation, not a carnival.
…I remember.
Fine. The steps are yours from midnight. Not one minute before.
Tonight. Hm. I'll leave the side door open. I never leave it open. Tonight.

scenes.title: Mission 35: Blackout protocol
scenes.context: Three nights before convocation, the whole grid fails. Sgt.

lines.text: I only switched it over! I'm switching it back! Wait!

scenes.title: Mission 36: Convocation night
scenes.context: Convocation night. The seniors graduate; every light on campus goes on at once; and Count Entropy, fully grown on a year of the school's fear, stands on the Senate steps.

lines.text: Thirty years I've stood on these steps. Never seen that. Never want to again.
Go and dance. Fresher no more.

scenes.title: Mission 37: Stalite
scenes.context: You come back from the break and somebody else's name is on your bed. Sort it out before dark, and find out what "stalite" means.

lines.text: The slip is correct. So this boy has nowhere. Hm.
Don't answer him. Answer me. What do we do with this boy?

scenes.title: Mission 42: Meter reader
scenes.context: Every evening, just before the campus goes dark, a Works van leaves the substation and drives to the mall. Follow it without being seen.

lines.text: I'm not sleeping. I'm observing.

scenes.title: Mission 45: Shuttle strike
scenes.context: The shuttle drivers have parked over unpaid allowances. Phase 2 is four kilometres away and full of stranded students.

lines.text: Three months. They say "next week". I have a family that eats this week.

scenes.title: Mission 46: Sly goes straight
scenes.context: Bolaji is opening a barber's chair in the mall. His old court boys think that is the funniest thing they have heard.

lines.text: Young man. Low cut. And take your time; a good thing is not rushed.

scenes.title: Mission 49: Chief Megawatt
scenes.context: The mall's owner invites you up. He would like to sponsor your department.

lines.text: My dear! Sit. Zobo? Malt? Think big, I always say.
I hear your department needs a projector. I like students. I was one, briefly.
My power is cheap because my engineer is clever. I don't ask how. Do you?

scenes.title: Mission 56: Light for everybody
scenes.context: The feeder must be switched back at three corners of campus, ninety seconds apart. Then a panel in the Senate asks what you saw, and reads your own choices back to you.

lines.text: Gate, then fire station, then the quad. Ninety seconds or it trips.

scenes.title: Mission 62: Past the last streetlight
scenes.context: With nothing to do you walk past the fence. Trees, then more trees.

lines.text: Go back.
Nothing out here for students. Bush, hills, and me. Go back.

scenes.title: Mission 65: Patrol games
scenes.context: Kaka said follow the white stones. There are a great many white stones.

lines.text: I know it's you. I can smell groundnut.

scenes.title: Mission 74: Ranger Lawal's debt
scenes.context: A patrol has not come back. He has turned you round three times.

lines.text: Two of my men. Since afternoon. The radio is only rain.
You know the old path better than my map. I'm asking.

scenes.title: Mission 77: Wedding at the quarters
scenes.context: Malam Garba's daughter is marrying. You need an outfit, a gift and a place in the dance line.

lines.text: He came. In thirty years he has not left that garden. He came.
For your roommate. You looked like someone who has a hungry roommate.
He came. Thirty years. I'll remember this wedding more than my own.
Don't tell my wife I said that. Go. Go.

scenes.title: Mission 79: IT letter
scenes.context: One letter, four stamps, three offices, two "come back tomorrow"s and a bank queue. Then a choice of where you train for six months.

lines.text: Patience, my child. The one who queues well, eats well.

scenes.title: Mission 80: First day at work
scenes.context: Your supervisor hands you a broom. Then a clipboard.

lines.text: IT student? Good. Sweep. Then we see who you are.

scenes.title: Mission 85: Payday
scenes.context: Your first real allowance: ₦60,000. Home needs some.

lines.text: Network. …It has paid. Congratulations. Next.

scenes.title: Mission 109: The Chancellor's shadow
scenes.context: A letter on every board: "Convocation is cancelled." No signature. The paper is cold.

lines.text: I did not post this. Nobody in this building posted this. Touch it.

scenes.title: Mission 114: Three by air and water
scenes.context: One pass over the tower beacon in a sky with no lights below. The eel lighting the spillway.

lines.text: Six floors. No lift; they have taken light. We carry.
lines.scene: Mission 114: Three by air and water

scenes.title: Mission 118: Convocation
scenes.context: The voices on the phone arrive in person. Show them round.

lines.text: So this is the gate. Hm. It's a good gate.

scenes.title: Mission 120: Fresher
scenes.context: One last ride round all of it, with the credits rolling past lamps you put up. Then, some years later, a new student at the gate asks you the way to the Senate.

lines.text: Go where you like. …Not too far. Old habits.

scenes.title: Security: warnings
scenes.context: A student is misbehaving. You shout a warning from a distance.

lines.text: Hey! Take it easy there!
You! Behave yourself!
I am watching you, my friend.
Slow down! This is a school!
I will not tell you again.

scenes.title: Security: the chase
scenes.context: The student ignored every warning. You are running after them.

lines.text: Stop there! Security!
Hold it! Come back here!
You! Stop!
There! By the road!

scenes.title: Security: warnings
scenes.context: A student is misbehaving. You shout a warning from a distance.

lines.text: Hey! Easy there.
We are watching you, fresher.
This is a school, not a motor park.
Last time I am telling you.
Do you want to see the Dean?

scenes.title: Mission 37: Stalite
scenes.context: You come back from the break and somebody else's name is on your bed. Sort it out before dark, and find out what "stalite" means.

lines.text: Bed space no dey. I told all of you: come early.
Bring your allocation slip from the Senate. Then we talk.
I know your face. The paper does not know your face.
Ah. Fresher no more. You have grown small.
Second years are "stalites". Returning light. Here. Your slip.
Last year you came here shaking. Now you came here annoyed. That is growth.
The ones who come back are the ones who stay. Greet your mother.
A wise porter. Out.

scenes.title: Mission 38: Grand opening
scenes.context: The market is now a mall. Hajiya Ladi's goods are at the gate, her new shop is upstairs, and the only escalator goes up.

lines.text: …Two minutes.
Is this a ride? Did I pay for this?

scenes.title: Mission 42: Meter reader
scenes.context: Every evening, just before the campus goes dark, a Works van leaves the substation and drives to the mall. Follow it without being seen.

lines.text: Yes. Yes, I'm coming. I said I'm coming.
Who is there? Identify yourself. Or don't. I'm going back to observing.

scenes.title: Mission 44: Iron Mama hums
scenes.context: The Maker has listened to the ground for a year. He sends you where he cannot go: under the mall, after closing, to see what is making the hum.

lines.text: If the generator ever goes off, I'm going home. I'm not checking.

scenes.title: Mission 45: Shuttle strike
scenes.context: The shuttle drivers have parked over unpaid allowances. Phase 2 is four kilometres away and full of stranded students.

lines.text: Bumps at the bridge. Goats at the checkpoint. Pray at the bend.
School fees on Monday. Allowance? "Next week." I've heard "next week" since May.
I'm not angry with you students. I'm angry with "next week".
One stamp is for the Registrar. The other is for my conscience.

scenes.title: Mission 46: Sly goes straight
scenes.context: Bolaji is opening a barber's chair in the mall. His old court boys think that is the funniest thing they have heard.

lines.text: Hm. Clean. I will tell the Registrar.

scenes.title: Mission 49: Chief Megawatt
scenes.context: The mall's owner invites you up. He would like to sponsor your department.

lines.text: Patience, my child. Some files are found by waiting near them.
I heard that. I like riddles. I like lawyers less. Sit.
Steel. Like my promises. Strong. Cold. Sometimes they rust.
When I was a student, that Senate had no light for a year. We studied by fire.
I promised myself: never again. For me. Notice I said "for me".
Everyone else is a business opportunity. Malt?

scenes.title: Mission 51: Change-Over
scenes.context: You know the driver's name now. He sees you coming and runs, through the market, on an okada.

lines.text: I only switched it over. One hour. Then two. Then every night.
They owe us six months. He paid on time. That is the whole story.
I left the markers. I think I wanted somebody to follow them.
Megawatt didn't ask me. His manager did. Cash in an envelope. I said yes once.
Once is a door. After that it's a corridor. You don't notice you're walking.
Bilkisu. I'm sorry about your fan. It was a bad fan. I did my best.

scenes.title: Mission 52: Phase 2 goes dark
scenes.context: While the feeder is argued over, Phase 2 has had no light for a week. Water, torches and charged phones go out in convoy on the long road at night.

lines.text: I'm on strike. This is not driving. This is visiting.
When it is dark, you sing! The dark hates music. Everybody knows.

scenes.title: Mission 54: Love in the time of NEPA
scenes.context: A plan for the evening. Then no light, and no money either.

lines.text: Network.
lines.scene: Mission 54: Love in the time of NEPA

scenes.title: Mission 55: Unplug Iron Mama (Heist 1: the mall plant room)
scenes.context: Plan it like professionals, earn the key from Sgt. Bilkisu on a night shift, then go down to a generator that has grown teeth, with your friends at every door.

lines.text: (laughing) Stop, stop, I have a heart condition!
lines.scene: Mission 55: Unplug Iron Mama (Heist 1: the mall plant room)

scenes.title: Mission 56: Light for everybody
scenes.context: The feeder must be switched back at three corners of campus, ninety seconds apart. Then a panel in the Senate asks what you saw, and reads your own choices back to you.

lines.text: I never asked where it came from. That, I am told, is the offence.
You told it straight. That is rarer than first class.
If it trips, the whole east side goes dark for a day. No pressure.
You know what's funny? I was going to pay. Eventually. Next week.
…Hm. Yes. That's what makes it funny.

scenes.title: Mission 60: Those who stayed
scenes.context: Count who is left: a tea seller, a nurse, a porter, a man with a coil, and you. No allowance is coming.

lines.text: An empty hostel gets dusty faster. Like a heart. Don't tell anybody I said that.

scenes.title: Mission 62: Past the last streetlight
scenes.context: With nothing to do you walk past the fence. Trees, then more trees.

lines.text: …Who told you that name? Only my grandmother calls me that.
I've turned back eleven students this week. You're number twelve.
Nobody stays home during a strike. They all come here to be bored outside.
Rice. Again. During a strike, even rangers eat garri.
Don't tell him about the garri. He'll make a joke. They always make a joke.
If you come back… come in the day. The bush is kind in the day.

scenes.title: Mission 65: Patrol games
scenes.context: Kaka said follow the white stones. There are a great many white stones.

lines.text: My grandmother sent you, didn't she? She sends everyone. Go home.
…Baba Ranger. That's what the boys call me. You can laugh.
Not you. You can't laugh.

scenes.title: Mission 69: The Idle King
scenes.context: NELT is full of it. You cannot hit silence, so bring a football crowd, an open mic, three radios and a bell.

lines.text: First warning. It's good, abi? Don't tell her.

scenes.title: Mission 70: Called off
scenes.context: The strike is over. The buses come back all at once, and Kabiru has hidden a treasure hunt across campus to welcome everybody.

lines.text: Welcome back! Shift! Shift for your future!

scenes.title: Mission 72: Workshop nights
scenes.context: Group Light Work's project: solar lamps for the dark road to Phase 2. Dr.

lines.text: Measure, then measure your measure.
Off before you touch. Always off. Then touch.
This one. The rest are opinions.

scenes.title: Mission 74: Ranger Lawal's debt
scenes.context: A patrol has not come back. He has turned you round three times.

lines.text: I told him it was a short cut. It was a long cut.
My grandmother says you buy her groundnuts and listen to the end.
Go where you like out there. Follow my light if you see it.
Don't say anything about the hat. Baba Ranger has a big head. Fine.
Left, left, right, stop, listen. Grandma, I'm listening.
She's always here. She's the only ranger who doesn't complain.
…and the goat said, "If you give me the office…" He's heard it eleven times.
I'm not dropping anyone. Grandmother would kill me. Then make me tea.
I wanted to study forestry. Real forestry. With books. I didn't get in.
So I became the forest's student instead. It teaches slower. And longer.
…Yes. Okay. You can call me that. You only.
There. That's what the bush sounds like when it's not afraid of you.
Usually it goes quiet when students come. It's quiet because you shout.
Grandmother!
You. Groundnut friend. Thank you. Don't tell anyone.
lines.tone: Ranger Lawal: at the gate, later

scenes.title: Mission 76: Heartbreak, or not
scenes.context: After months apart, somebody is not where they used to be. Listen first.

lines.text: You never listen! …I'm sorry. You listen. I never talk. Let's get suya.

scenes.title: Mission 77: Wedding at the quarters
scenes.context: Malam Garba's daughter is marrying. You need an outfit, a gift and a place in the dance line.

lines.text: Another one. Welcome, my child. And you: tomorrow. Do not be late.

scenes.title: Mission 78: Lights on the long road
scenes.context: Demo day on the quad, exams in a hurry, and then the last lamp. At dusk the whole road to Phase 2 lights up, pole by pole, and everybody rides it.

lines.text: Shift! Shift for your neighbour! Everybody shift, there is light for all!
lines.scene: Mission 78: Lights on the long road

scenes.title: Mission 79: IT letter
scenes.context: One letter, four stamps, three offices, two "come back tomorrow"s and a bank queue. Then a choice of where you train for six months.

lines.text: …It has come. Quickly, before it goes.
Come back after lunch.
Then come back after the next lunch.

scenes.title: Mission 80: First day at work
scenes.context: Your supervisor hands you a broom. Then a clipboard.

lines.text: Five days, five pens' worth of truth. Good. Monday you get keys.
Same ink. Same hand. Same hour. I was a student too. Do better.
You are early. Good. Early people sweep.
Three of you were here at 07:45 on a public holiday. Interesting.
I also wrote my logbook on Friday night. Once. Never again. Guess why.
The goat has reviewed your work. It found it delicious. Rewrite it.

scenes.title: Mission 82: The collab
scenes.context: Lucky wants three stunts for one video: a wheelie down the boulevard, a wave from the Senate steps, a keke full of goats. Then you go to buy socks and forty people want a picture.

lines.text: Is this for school? …Carry on. But greet first.
Are you waving at me? Then I will wave back. Now we are both in your video.

scenes.title: Mission 94: Election day
scenes.context: Comrade Sadiya is running again and Yakubu is her manager. Posters, a debate card that says "second speaker", and a ballot box that turns out to be under the returning officer's chair.

lines.text: It was safe there. Very safe. I was sitting on democracy.

scenes.title: Mission 97: Log off
scenes.context: What do you do with being known? Then a logbook on a table and a panel in a row: the industrial-training defence.

lines.text: The student wrote everything on Friday once. Then never again. Promising.

scenes.title: Mission 103: Sixth site (Heist 2: the Senate basement)
scenes.context: The sixth plaque says only "at the centre". One reference is in a room the library does not admit to having, four corners of campus have to be measured, and the centre turns out to be a room

lines.text: I was told: one day a student will ask for this key. You did not ask. Hm.
lines.scene: Mission 103: Sixth site (Heist 2: the Senate basement)

lines.text: But you came the way he used to come. Through the hatch. Here. It is oiled.
lines.scene: Mission 103: Sixth site (Heist 2: the Senate basement)

scenes.title: Mission 104: Megawatt's offer
scenes.context: The coil costs more than a keke. Raise it honestly, or let Chief Megawatt pay for all of it and put his name on the tower.

lines.text: My dear! I hear you're building a tower thing. I'll pay. All of it. Today.
I only ask a small plaque. "The Megawatt Coil". Think big.
The Megawatt Tower. Big letters. Your name small. Very small.

scenes.title: Mission 106: Build week
scenes.context: Frame. Two thousand turns of copper.

lines.text: Who is the senior here? You? Then you count. Loudly.

scenes.title: Mission 109: The Chancellor's shadow
scenes.context: A letter on every board: "Convocation is cancelled." No signature. The paper is cold.

lines.text: Cancelled? I have been here forty years. Convocation is never cancelled.
Never cancel convocation. That is the first rule of my religion.

scenes.title: Mission 113: Three by road
scenes.context: The Garden, the Mall and Old Campus, relit in one run. Everyone you met in Year 1 holds the first.

lines.text: My dear! Tell me what to carry. No, truly. Tell me.
I'm at the breaker. When you seat it, shout. This time I switch it the right way.
Follow my light. Don't look at the trees. They're only trees. Mostly.
MY GRANDMOTHER CORNERS FASTER! …I LOVE YOU ALL!
Year Two, you nearly flooded my plant room. Now I give you the key. Life.

scenes.title: Mission 118: Convocation
scenes.context: The voices on the phone arrive in person. Show them round.

lines.text: I hear my child signs for your tools. …And returns them? Good.
Five years ago I gave you a file. Today I give you a chair. Sit in it properly.
You built a coil? …Good. Your grandfather built a fence once. Also good.
Forty years I have read these names. Yours I read twice. In my head.
Forty years. First time anyone fed me at convocation.

scenes.title: Mission 119: Sign-out
scenes.context: A white shirt and a box of markers. What each friend writes depends on five years of what you did.

lines.text: Bed space no dey. …There is one. Yours. Who gets it?

scenes.title: Side mission 10: Bolaji's trick
scenes.context: He wants the stair set outside the Senate. Keep Malam Garba talking.

lines.text: Young man. Was that you? …Was it clean? Then I saw nothing.

scenes.title: Side mission 25: Lucky's first video
scenes.context: Before the followers, his "day in the life" video has nothing happening in it.

lines.text: You're blocking the road. Thoughtfully. Move.

scenes.title: Side mission 32: Coach Danladi's speech
scenes.context: He must give a prize-giving speech without shouting or crying. Rehearse him.

lines.text: I AM VERY PROUD— (quieter) I am very proud of—
AGAIN! (whispers) again.
Racing Club… (sob) Give me one minute. These boys are my sons.
(afterwards) Four words. I wrote four pages. The four words were enough.
Softly. Look at that. I can do softly now.

scenes.title: Side mission 35: Oga Pee's shortcuts
scenes.context: He trades five shortcuts for five sticks of suya.

lines.text: I'm not sleeping. I'm observing. …What I observe is suya. Five sticks.
Now you know everything I know. Which is a lot. With eyes closed.
Shortcut three. Don't tell the ranger. Shortcut four. Tell nobody.
Every shortcut. Every shortcut ends at suya.
Don't ask me why this bench is warm. I don't ask. I just sit.

scenes.title: Side mission 36: Lawal's grandmother
scenes.context: Carry a parcel from the mall to the forest edge. He is too proud to say who it is for.

lines.text: A parcel. For someone. Don't open it. Don't shake it. Go back. No— go.
That is a neem. It is older than your jokes. Go away, Jega.

scenes.title: Side mission 44: Baba Shuttle's last trip
scenes.context: His bus is being retired. Ride the full route with him and name the regulars.

lines.text: That one's mother rode with me. And her mother. Shift for them.
