roles.who: Anyone. Two or three people can pass the phone round.
roles.characters: A passer-by, Somebody nearby, Aminu, Crowd, Fresher, A Patient, A Fresher, A Student, Boy From Town, Foreman, Racer, Colleague, Senior, Everyone, A Child, Passenger, A Senior, A Colleague and others
roles.sound: People walking past who react, comment and ask for help; children and one-line parts. Surprised, annoyed, amused: short and real. Use your own natural voice and your normal Nigerian English. Speak Pidgin, Hausa, Yoruba or Igbo exactly where it is written. Do not put on a voice or an accent.

scenes.title: Mission 0: Opening: arriving
scenes.context: Your family's car brings you through the Main Gate on registration morning. Your parents help with the bags, the porter takes them to your room, you meet your roommate, and then they have to go.

lines.text: Fresher! Your mother is still at the gate!
Excuse me… which way is the Senate?
Follow the orange building. You can't miss it. Everybody misses it.

scenes.title: Mission 4: They have taken light
scenes.context: The power goes off. Everyone shouts "Ah, they have taken light!" like every night.

lines.text: Ah! They have taken light!
Up NEPA!

scenes.title: Mission 7: Fresher tax
scenes.context: At the court, a big boy who calls himself "Big Sly" is charging freshers ₦500 to walk past it. Today, he wants yours.

lines.text: Ah! He's blocking! Who taught freshers to block?

scenes.title: Mission 13: Keke Grand Prix
scenes.context: The Ring Road Grand Prix: twelve kekes, one lap of the whole campus, a trophy made of an old exhaust pipe sprayed gold. Half the campus is watching.

lines.text: …Yes. Yes I do. Stand closer.
My wheel! My wheel is going to Phase 2 without me!

scenes.title: Mission 19: Up NEPA party
scenes.context: The light has stayed on for a whole week. DJ Kabiru says that deserves noise, and he needs a crowd, a snack table and somebody brave enough to dance first.

lines.text: Eh eh eh.
Main character energy!
Faaa!
Ahn ahn!
John Carter! John Carter!

scenes.title: Mission 22: Senate Sprint
scenes.context: The Senate Sprint is one lap of the Senate and back, the shortest race on campus and the dirtiest. Coach Danladi enters you.

lines.text: No gree for anybody!
Big Sly is clapping? Who did this to him?

scenes.title: Mission 26: East Side Drift
scenes.context: The East Side Drift is a car race round the tightest corners on campus. Kelechi lost it last year to a senior who "drove like a poem".

lines.text: Gbas gbos!
That's so cringe!
Kelechi? He brakes like he's carving. Very careful. Very slow. Very art.
He looks at the corner too long. Like it owes him money.

scenes.title: Mission 27: What the net caught
scenes.context: Something in the water at the Dam took Baba Dam's net and dragged it under. Tonight the net came back, and it is full of something that is not fish.

lines.text: Leave am!

scenes.title: Mission 29: Night market
scenes.context: With the Maker gone four days and the market dark at night, a gang of older boys calling themselves "the levy" are going stall to stall, collecting a "light fee" for lamps that don't exist.

lines.text: Fresher. You're in the wrong market. Light fee. ₦1,000. Or go home.
I'm recording!
Okay! Okay! We're going. It's just… nobody pays us when there's light.
And don't come back! I've been throwing slippers since your father was a levy boy!
Emotional damage!

scenes.title: Mission 31: The second eel
scenes.context: The thing in the water that pulled Baba Dam's net is a mother eel, very old and very large. Since the Maker's absence, the shades have been gathering on her, and she is lashing at

lines.text: Omo!
Is that a snake? Is that a train? Is that a snake train?

scenes.title: Mission 32: Six plaques
scenes.context: The Maker has the dynamo. To use it he needs three more things: a perfect answer, copper winding and a spark gap.

lines.text: John Carter can wind! Who knew?

scenes.title: Mission 33: School Marathon
scenes.context: The School Marathon is the whole campus on foot. Coach Danladi's prize this year is a generator, donated by the traders.

lines.text: Run! Or I'll throw this!
Waaa!

scenes.title: Mission 36: Convocation night
scenes.context: Convocation night. The seniors graduate; every light on campus goes on at once; and Count Entropy, fully grown on a year of the school's fear, stands on the Senate steps.

lines.text: Fresher! Is this convocation or a film?

scenes.title: Mission 57: Sign-out, small
scenes.context: Second-semester exams in steady light. Then the final-years sign out in white shirts, and you hold the markers.

lines.text: You're the one from the basement. Write your name. So I remember who put the light on.

scenes.title: Mission 61: Small Sadiq
scenes.context: A boy at Demonstration school wants to be an engineer "like you". This time you ask the questions, and choose how to explain when he gets one wrong.

lines.text: Are you the engineer? Uncle Sadiq said an engineer is coming.
Can you make light? Can you make a car? Can you make jollof?
Is it not so? You said so yourself. Last time. Differently.

scenes.title: Mission 77: Wedding at the quarters
scenes.context: Malam Garba's daughter is marrying. You need an outfit, a gift and a place in the dance line.

lines.text: You! Second year? Third? Married? No? Why? Sit there. Eat.

scenes.title: Mission 80: First day at work
scenes.context: Your supervisor hands you a broom. Then a clipboard.

lines.text: Don't touch it. …Do you know what it is? Then touch it. Carefully.

scenes.title: Mission 82: The collab
scenes.context: Lucky wants three stunts for one video: a wheelie down the boulevard, a wave from the Senate steps, a keke full of goats. Then you go to buy socks and forty people want a picture.

lines.text: It's them! Do the move! Do the move!

scenes.title: Mission 84: Workplace accident
scenes.context: A colleague is down. Stop the bleeding, keep them talking, drive to the Sick Bay gently.

lines.text: My hand! It was off! I swear it was off!

scenes.title: Mission 89: Cancelled
scenes.context: A clip of "you" shoving a fresher. It is an Echo.

lines.text: I used to like them.
If you took the drink money, you can take a fresher's lunch.
lines.tone: A passer-by: overheard in passing; only if dealdrink

scenes.title: Mission 92: Double booking
scenes.context: Two people were promised the same evening. If it was you, face it.

lines.text: You told me you had a test that night.
lines.tone: First: SECOND: That was my birthday.

scenes.title: Mission 98: Sadiq's surprise
scenes.context: You owe your roommate an apology for most of this year. Before you can give it, the whole room shouts "surprise".

lines.text: SURPRISE!

scenes.title: Mission 100: Finalist
scenes.context: Mission one hundred. Freshers call you "senior" and step off the path.

lines.text: Senior, please, where is the Senate?
Senior, is it true you fought a generator?
Senior, you get garri?
Sorry, senior. Is this your bed? The list says it's mine.

scenes.title: Mission 107: Failure (the dream)
scenes.context: Your supervisor says start again. It is raining.

lines.text: Do you think it will work if I just keep it running? Alone? Forever?
No. I didn't think so either.

scenes.title: Mission 119: Sign-out
scenes.context: A white shirt and a box of markers. What each friend writes depends on five years of what you did.

lines.text: You walked me to the Senate. In my first week. You won't remember.
Abeg, help me buy bread. Keep the change.
Mummy said buy sweets. Mummy didn't say how. Help me.
Drop me at NELT! Two minutes! I'll pray for you!
KT, not WT! People always take me to WT!
My department. Any department. I forgot which hall.
Shuttle has closed. You dey go Phase 2?
Dangote side. I'll pay in groundnuts.
Dan Fodio. Drive slowly; I have eggs.
Please, where is the Senate?
Which one is the library? They all look like libraries.
I'm looking for the Engineering… square? Circle?
Lend me your elbow to Kainji. I'll do the talking.
Left at the noisy tree. You'll see. I mean, you'll hear.
Don't count steps for me. I've counted them since first year.
Can we walk with you past here?
The lamp is dead again. Stay close.
Talk loudly. Shades don't like talk.
I'm fine. I'm fine. I'm not fine.
My knee has opened. Sick Bay, please, gently.
Forget me, check the bike!
She hasn't eaten. Help me carry her.
Fan him. Fan harder. Use your file.
Did I fall? Did anybody film it?
Sick Bay. Slowly. Slowly!
Carry me like a hero. Not like a bag of rice.
The match is on Saturday. Tell me it's not broken.
One question from Circuits. Just one.
How does this formula work? Not why. How.
My test is in an hour. Explain like I'm a fresher. I am a fresher.
Hold the seat. Don't let go. You let go!
I'm not scared. I'm respecting the bicycle.
Is it normal for the bicycle to go where it wants?
Show me that one move. Just that one.
My hall has a dance-off. I have two left feet and one week.
Slowly. Slower. Now fast. No, slowly.
No ID, no exam. It's blue. Everything is blue!
It has my worst photo on it. Find it before anybody sees.
I had it at the buka. Then I had rice. Then I didn't have it.
My whole project. Black. This small.
If I lose it, I lose a year. No pressure.
It says 'Final final FINAL'. Don't open it.
Catch it! Its name is Professor!
It ate my homework. Really. Look at its face.
Don't chase. Call it softly. 'Professor…'
Give her this. Don't read it.
Give him this. If he laughs, take it back.
It's not a love note. It's a… note of interest.
Just ask her friend. Casually.
Find out if he's seeing anybody. Like a detective.
Don't say my name. Describe me nicely.

scenes.title: Encounter 18: Sit with me while I ask

lines.text: Just stand there. Not so close.
lines.scene: Encounter 18: Sit with me while I ask

lines.text: If I freeze, cough twice.
lines.scene: Encounter 18: Sit with me while I ask

lines.text: I've written it on my hand. It's smudged.
lines.scene: Encounter 18: Sit with me while I ask

lines.text: I was first. I was first.
She has three buckets. I have one dream.
The tap is free. The water is not.
Are you seeing this?
Oga, the queue starts there. There. Far.
We have been here since morning. Morning of yesterday.
Tell him I said…
He borrowed my charger and my peace of mind.
It's not the money. It's the principle. It's also the money.
Mine was on 2%!
I have a presentation. You have WhatsApp.
There are four phones and one socket. This is a crisis.
One call. To my mum. Please.
Just enough to send one message. One.
Power bank? You're an angel. A rich angel.
Two minutes!
Don't let anybody near it. Especially the goat.
Everything I own is in there. And my lunch.
Can you wait till it comes?
It's quiet tonight. Talk to me about anything.
My friend is late. Pretend to be my friend.
We need noise. Bring noise.
If you cheer, we'll win. That's science.
Shout my name. Not my nickname.
Young man, young woman, a small push.
It starts on the third push. Always the third.
Don't tell my students I drive this.
Give this to Chidinma, Queen Amina, room 14.
Tell him his mother says eat. Then give him the cooler.
Don't open it. It's soup. It knows if you open it.
Snap us! Wait, wait, one more.
From below. Make us look tall.
Get the letters in. All the letters.
I'm okay. …Can you sit small?
Don't ask me anything. Just stay a bit.
Everybody is so busy. I'm busy being still.
I'm not hungry. I'm just asking who has garri. For research.
One cup. I'll pay you back in gratitude.

scenes.context: Alhaji Needle will sew your first native. It will be ready Thursday.

lines.text: The green one shouts. The indigo one whispers. The white one judges.
Same shirt as Monday? Inside life. Respect the commitment.
THURSDAY!

scenes.title: Mission 40: Level two, round one
scenes.context: Basit holds every high score in the Game Room. He lets you pick the machine.

lines.text: Again?
Somebody is beating Basit's warm-up score. Call people.
Are you even trying?

scenes.title: Mission 41: The mall never blinks
scenes.context: The whole campus goes dark at once. Across the road the mall is glowing like a ship.

lines.text: Shey na only me? My phone is on 4 percent. Talk fast, darkness.
Gone walking. Keep the tea warm. The dark is a teacher.
lines.tone: Note: read aloud by the player

scenes.title: Mission 42: Meter reader
scenes.context: Every evening, just before the campus goes dark, a Works van leaves the substation and drives to the mall. Follow it without being seen.

lines.text: Why mine?

scenes.title: Mission 44: Iron Mama hums
scenes.context: The Maker has listened to the ground for a year. He sends you where he cannot go: under the mall, after closing, to see what is making the hum.

lines.text: Third door. Don't touch the red one. And if anybody asks, I mopped you out.

scenes.title: Mission 45: Shuttle strike
scenes.context: The shuttle drivers have parked over unpaid allowances. Phase 2 is four kilometres away and full of stranded students.

lines.text: Driver, shift! Shift for your neighbour!
I have a test at two. If I fail, it is this keke.
Your knee is in my lap.
Your lap is in my knee's way.

scenes.title: Mission 50: Bolaji's board
scenes.context: A skate contest in the mall car park. Bolaji, all six feet of him, needs a spotter, somebody to film, and somebody to believe it.

lines.text: Good afternoon, sir. Your board is very… big. Like you.
Sir, can you teach me?

scenes.title: Mission 51: Change-Over
scenes.context: You know the driver's name now. He sees you coming and runs, through the market, on an okada.

lines.text: Are you Daddy's friends? He said friends would come one day.

scenes.title: Mission 53: The second coil
scenes.context: The Maker reads the second plaque aloud. The coil under the mall needs three parts.

lines.text: You want me to move? For what? For a plate? I've sat here eleven years.
…Fine. That was a good one.

scenes.title: Mission 56: Light for everybody
scenes.context: The feeder must be switched back at three corners of campus, ninety seconds apart. Then a panel in the Senate asks what you saw, and reads your own choices back to you.

lines.text: Daddy says you're the friends. Are you still the friends?

scenes.title: Mission 57: Sign-out, small
scenes.context: Second-semester exams in steady light. Then the final-years sign out in white shirts, and you hold the markers.

lines.text: Write something! No, not there. Somebody's mother will read this.
Don't be like us. Be better. Also return my bucket.

scenes.title: Mission 59: Indefinite
scenes.context: A sheet of paper on the Senate door. A congress at Theatre CD.

lines.text: Indefinite? Like my relationship?
E choke. Even the strike doesn't know when it ends.

scenes.title: Mission 60: Those who stayed
scenes.context: Count who is left: a tea seller, a nurse, a porter, a man with a coil, and you. No allowance is coming.

lines.text: …Fine. Take me round the fountain four more times.

scenes.title: Mission 61: Small Sadiq
scenes.context: A boy at Demonstration school wants to be an engineer "like you". This time you ask the questions, and choose how to explain when he gets one wrong.

lines.text: When I come to your school, will you show me the Senate?
Our teacher went home. I stayed. My uncle Sadiq says staying is a skill.
Why? …But why? …And why is that? …Is there an end to why?
Good. I don't want an end.
Electricity!
You put the battery backwards. My uncle showed me your notes. Last year.
He said they were good. Mostly. Except the battery.
There's a man with this machine. Everybody says he's a ghost. Is he a ghost?
Ghosts can drink tea. I'm not convinced.
He salutes the gate man too. And the goats. You're in good company.
Uncle says I must say thank you properly. Thank you properly.
Also, ghosts drink tea. I checked. I'm still not convinced.

scenes.title: Mission 68: Night nurse
scenes.context: The Sick Bay generator is on its last cup. Fetch four jerrycans, driving as if eggs were in the back.

lines.text: Everybody went home. I didn't have transport. Then I got malaria.
Is it true the lecture halls are full of ghosts? Don't tell me. Tell me.
Strike price. Don't look at me like that. My children also strike for food.
That goat is my father's name. My father thinks it's an honour. It's an honour.
My grandmother. Kaduna. Everybody's grandmother sang this.
Is it morning? Is the strike over? No? Then why is everybody smiling?

scenes.title: Mission 69: The Idle King
scenes.context: NELT is full of it. You cannot hit silence, so bring a football crowd, an open mic, three radios and a bell.

lines.text: Faaa! E choke!

scenes.title: Mission 73: Test run
scenes.context: The first lamp goes up at dusk on the darkest bend. It comes on.

lines.text: Good morning, sir. We didn't know it was your lamp. Is it your lamp?
…Oh. Everybody's. Then it's also mine?
God when? A lamp on the Phase 2 road. Who did this to us? In a good way?
Main character energy. That lamp is the main character now.
Sir, sweeping first or kickflip first?
lines.tone: Boy From Town: at Saturday class

scenes.title: Mission 76: Heartbreak, or not
scenes.context: After months apart, somebody is not where they used to be. Listen first.

lines.text: For anybody who said the true thing tonight. It costs. It's worth it.

scenes.title: Mission 78: Lights on the long road
scenes.context: Demo day on the quad, exams in a hurry, and then the last lamp. At dusk the whole road to Phase 2 lights up, pole by pole, and everybody rides it.

lines.text: Who soldered the head?
lines.scene: Mission 78: Lights on the long road

lines.text: THE ROAD!
lines.scene: Mission 78: Lights on the long road

scenes.title: Mission 79: IT letter
scenes.context: One letter, four stamps, three offices, two "come back tomorrow"s and a bank queue. Then a choice of where you train for six months.

lines.text: The quiet one's student. Good. Bring patience, not shoes.
Is that goat on SIWES?

scenes.title: Mission 80: First day at work
scenes.context: Your supervisor hands you a broom. Then a clipboard.

lines.text: IT boy, eat. You are thin like a signature.

scenes.title: Mission 81: Lucky goes viral
scenes.context: Somebody filmed your dance at The Floor and put a beat under it. By lunch the whole school has seen it, and a brand wants your feet.

lines.text: Senior! Do the leg thing!
Quickly. For science. …Thank you. Back to Ohm's law.

scenes.title: Mission 82: The collab
scenes.context: Lucky wants three stunts for one video: a wheelie down the boulevard, a wave from the Senate steps, a keke full of goats. Then you go to buy socks and forty people want a picture.

lines.text: Buy socks first, then photos. Business before fame.

scenes.title: Mission 84: Workplace accident
scenes.context: A colleague is down. Stop the bleeding, keep them talking, drive to the Sick Bay gently.

lines.text: Tell me something. Anything. Tell me about that goat video.
Tell my mother I was very handsome.
That pothole knew my name.
Nurse Hauwa said it was the only bandage left. I look rich.
My mother says you are now her son. Sorry. She has many sons.

scenes.title: Mission 85: Payday
scenes.context: Your first real allowance: ₦60,000. Home needs some.

lines.text: The price is ₦58,000, or a story the Maker likes. He hasn't liked any.

scenes.title: Mission 89: Cancelled
scenes.context: A clip of "you" shoving a fresher. It is an Echo.

lines.text: Sorry, senior. Please don't shove me. I have exams.
I don't remember you shoving me. But everyone says you did. Sorry?

scenes.title: Mission 92: Double booking
scenes.context: Two people were promised the same evening. If it was you, face it.

lines.text: Maybe in another semester. People change. I want to see if you do.
I saw you at the coil build. You looked honest. Coffee? Just coffee.

scenes.title: Mission 94: Election day
scenes.context: Comrade Sadiya is running again and Yakubu is her manager. Posters, a debate card that says "second speaker", and a ballot box that turns out to be under the returning officer's chair.

lines.text: What will your candidate do about water in the halls? Forty seconds.
I know what you did. You put posters on my board. Mine. Rude.

scenes.title: Mission 97: Log off
scenes.context: What do you do with being known? Then a logbook on a table and a panel in a row: the industrial-training defence.

lines.text: Describe one failure. Not a success disguised as a failure. A real one.
And you, young man? Why are you here?

scenes.title: Mission 99: One left
scenes.context: Kelechi's final piece is under a sheet and too heavy for one. He signs this one, and leaves a year ahead of you.

lines.text: Is that the Maker? Made of stone?

scenes.title: Mission 102: Fresher tax, reversed
scenes.context: A new boy at the court is taxing freshers. Big Sly would like a word with him.

lines.text: Tax is tax. Ask anybody. It's tradition.
Court fee. The court is very maintained. Look at the lines.

scenes.title: Mission 103: Sixth site (Heist 2: the Senate basement)
scenes.context: The sixth plaque says only "at the centre". One reference is in a room the library does not admit to having, four corners of campus have to be measured, and the centre turns out to be a room

lines.text: You're the funny one. My daughter loves you. Stay away from her.
lines.scene: Mission 103: Sixth site (Heist 2: the Senate basement)

scenes.title: Mission 104: Megawatt's offer
scenes.context: The coil costs more than a keke. Raise it honestly, or let Chief Megawatt pay for all of it and put his name on the tower.

lines.text: Keep your name on what you build. — M.

scenes.title: Mission 105: Parts from everywhere
scenes.context: Six people each have one thing the coil needs. Each asks one small thing in return.

lines.text: Wood again. The cliff tower took it all, then never got finished. Take this.
Tell me a story about my granddaughter that she doesn't know I know.

scenes.title: Mission 107: Failure (the dream)
scenes.context: Your supervisor says start again. It is raining.

lines.text: Mine is the best section. If theirs fail, that's not my problem.
I don't need help. Help is for people who can't.
I'll show them. When it works, they'll see it was me.
I'm not talking to her. She took my soldering iron in March.
I'm going home if this doesn't work by Friday.
He'll build lamps one day. He's afraid of the dark.

scenes.title: Mission 108: Everybody, again
scenes.context: Ten departments, one section of coil each, wound together in one hall. Go round the quad and ask.

lines.text: Nobody ever asks Mining. Yes. Before you change your mind.
Yes. Done. Why are you still here?
How much concrete? You don't need concrete? Then why are you talking to me?
…Snacks? Fine. I'm only coming for the snacks.
Khalid? Anything. Anything for Khalid.

scenes.title: Mission 112: The longest night
scenes.context: Every light on campus goes at once and does not come back: lamps, mall, the long road, all five coils. Hold your hostel till the torches arrive, then walk three hundred students out.

lines.text: I'm fine. I'm not fine. Is this normal?

scenes.title: Mission 114: Three by air and water
scenes.context: One pass over the tower beacon in a sky with no lights below. The eel lighting the spillway.

lines.text: Same story. Ran out of wood. One day someone will finish it. Not today.
lines.scene: Mission 114: Three by air and water

scenes.title: Mission 115: Chancellor Null
scenes.context: On the roof: a blank figure in a gown. It does not attack.

lines.text: (no voice; the letter reads) "Stay. Nothing will change. Ever."

scenes.title: Mission 117: Gown
scenes.context: A name on a board, a gown from the mall, and five photographs in five places with whoever mattered most there.

lines.text: Five years. Some good, some "we'll see". I'm glad we saw.
Congratulations. I mean it. Take a photo with us both. Make it weird.

scenes.title: Mission 118: Convocation
scenes.context: The voices on the phone arrive in person. Show them round.

lines.text: You, the tall one with the bucket, are you married? Why not?

scenes.title: Mission 120: Fresher
scenes.context: One last ride round all of it, with the credits rolling past lamps you put up. Then, some years later, a new student at the gate asks you the way to the Senate.

lines.text: Excuse me. Where is the Senate?
Wood came this morning. Don't know who sent it. Maybe this year. Maybe not.
Is this yours? The garri? Can I…?

scenes.title: Side mission 2: Sadiq sends money
scenes.context: He asks you to queue at the bank with him and not ask why.

lines.text: Sapa has entered the chat. And the chat is this queue.

scenes.title: Side mission 5: Ada's fees
scenes.context: A deadline, a queue, and a quiet favour from Dr. Khadija that Ada must never hear about.

lines.text: Is this the fees queue or the "I have given up" queue?

scenes.title: Side mission 6: Yakubu's attendance sheet
scenes.context: The sheet is missing and the lecturer wants it by four. Forty signatures in forty places.

lines.text: I'll sign if you hold my suya. Don't eat it. I counted the pieces.
Forty signatures? I can do four handwritings. Don't tell anyone.

scenes.title: Side mission 13: The eighth statue
scenes.context: Someone painted a moustache on the unsigned statue. Kelechi is far too upset for a stranger's work.

lines.text: It was a dare! The statue looked lonely! Moustaches are friendly!

scenes.title: Side mission 14: Emeka's keke
scenes.context: He has saved for two years. Go with him to buy it and stop him paying the first price.

lines.text: Last price, ₦600,000. - EMEKA: Done!
For you, my brother, special price. Very special. Like a wedding.

scenes.title: Side mission 17: Joy's night show
scenes.context: The anonymous host has lost her voice. Read the dedications.

lines.text: Is this the usual host? You sound different. Nicer? No, same. Thank you.

scenes.title: Side mission 28: Hajiya's ledger
scenes.context: Three students owe nothing because somebody always pays. Deliver three receipts and say nothing.

lines.text: Paid? By who? I've been eating garri for two weeks to save for this.

scenes.title: Side mission 30: Nurse Hauwa's list
scenes.context: Check on four students from her list, as if by accident.

lines.text: I'm fine. Why are you looking at me like the nurse?
…Okay. It's my dad. Can we sit somewhere?

scenes.title: Side mission 32: Coach Danladi's speech
scenes.context: He must give a prize-giving speech without shouting or crying. Rehearse him.

lines.text: (chanting) Coach! Coach! Coach!
That was the best speech ever. It was four words.

scenes.title: Side mission 42: Chi-Tech's photos
scenes.context: A cracked phone with a stranger's family pictures. Find the owner from three clues.

lines.text: My late husband is in there. I thought I lost him twice. Thank you, my child.

scenes.title: Side mission 44: Baba Shuttle's last trip
scenes.context: His bus is being retired. Ride the full route with him and name the regulars.

lines.text: Baba, you drove my mother to her convocation. Drive me to mine. Next year.
lines.scene: Side mission 44: Baba Shuttle's last trip

lines.text: Twenty years on this bus. My children grew up on these seats.
lines.scene: Side mission 44: Baba Shuttle's last trip

scenes.title: Side mission 47: The visit
scenes.context: Fellowship members visit the Sick Bay. Carry fruit, read a letter aloud, fix a fan.

lines.text: Read it slowly. It's from my mother. She writes slowly.
The fan has been off for three days. Three. I'm melting like garri in hot water.

scenes.title: Side mission 50: Aminu's first day
scenes.context: He has admission. Walk him to the Senate.

lines.text: This way. I think. Is it this way? I knew that.
The Senate is this way. I think. The orange building? Is everything orange?
Who was that?
Is that a riddle or a ghost story?

scenes.title: Side mission 54: The runaway horse
scenes.context: The grey mare has escaped and is visiting campus, eating every orange she can find.

lines.text: She never lets anyone ride. She likes you. That's dangerous.

scenes.title: Side mission 56: The cliff tower (Year 4)
scenes.context: The half-built tower from Year 3. Asabe wants to try again.

lines.text: We ran out of wood. Again. The tower is patient. Come back with more.

scenes.title: Side mission 63: Tanko's riddle slips
scenes.context: Twelve riddle slips hidden around campus; each answer is a place.

lines.text: Where do the dancers look when nobody looks at them?

scenes.title: Around campus: fighting back
scenes.context: Somebody hit you and you are not having it.

lines.text: You think I can't fight?
Take your own!
Oya, collect!
Try me again!

scenes.context: You have had enough and you give up.

lines.text: Okay okay! It's enough!

scenes.context: You are picking yourself up off the ground.

scenes.context: A fight has broken out near you.

lines.text: I am recording o.
World Star!
This one is going online.
You hit somebody! Stop!
Driver! You have knocked person!
Security! Security!

scenes.title: Mission 1: Welcome, fresher
scenes.context: Registration day. You arrive with one bag, one admission letter and a mother's list of instructions.

lines.text: My mother is still at the gate. She says she is "just looking".
I've been in this queue so long I've made friends. And enemies.

scenes.title: Mission 2: Belle first
scenes.context: Day one of real life: eat, go to class, survive, come home. Simple.

lines.text: I said "present" and I wasn't even in the room. I was outside. Present outside.
Who is that girl drawing better than the lecturer? I'm scared of her. Respectfully.

scenes.title: Mission 3: Two wheels
scenes.context: The campus is big and your legs are small. Emeka at the gate has a bicycle that needs a rider and a box of books that needs to reach the Library before Mrs.

lines.text: That goat has a name. Nobody knows it. She has a sense of humour.
I saw a boy dry a book with his sleeve. Who raised him? I want his mother's number.

scenes.title: Mission 4: They have taken light
scenes.context: The power goes off. Everyone shouts "Ah, they have taken light!" like every night.

lines.text: I was ironing. Half my shirt is flat. The other half is philosophy.
Something touched my foot. It was the darkness. I'm transferring to Phase 2.

scenes.title: Mission 5: The missing fuse
scenes.context: Dr. Okonkwo says the blackouts aren't Works Department laziness: a fuse is missing from the campus feeder.

lines.text: Electrical people have a different smell. Like rain that thinks too much.
Bolaji just called someone John Carter and the whole yard laughed. Even the motor.

scenes.title: Mission 6: Mai Shayi knows
scenes.context: Mai Shayi Audu knows every rumour on campus and sells it with tea. He says the shades gather in the Sculpture Garden.

lines.text: Why does the professor's statue cry rust? It doesn't even rain. It's harmattan.
An old man asked me a riddle and I've been thinking about it since Tuesday.

scenes.title: Mission 7: Fresher tax
scenes.context: At the court, a big boy who calls himself "Big Sly" is charging freshers ₦500 to walk past it. Today, he wants yours.

lines.text: I paid Sly twice. Once he said the first payment was a "registration fee".
Did you see him freeze? One word. "Bolaji." Like a remote control.

scenes.title: Mission 8: Run am
scenes.context: Word of the court has gone round. Jega, the hall football captain, wants to see if the fresher who blocked Big Sly's boys can also ride.

lines.text: Jega wears the same socks every match. Washed? We don't talk about it.
I asked Jega his girlfriend's name and he said "I don't know" and smiled. Romantic.

scenes.title: Mission 9: Sly's last stand
scenes.context: Bolaji has heard about the race. He doesn't like freshers who are talked about more than he is.

lines.text: Sly sat down at Mama Nkechi's. Sly. Sat. I need to lie down.
Big Baby said one word and the storm went home. Love is electrical.

scenes.title: Mission 10: Stone that points
scenes.context: Light mission, a Saturday walk. Kelechi, the sculpture student a year ahead, says three of the statues point.

lines.text: The pastor and the ustaz drink tea together every Saturday. Nobody's allowed to join.
Why does the goat statue have a cap again? Who is doing this? I respect them.

scenes.title: Mission 11: Baba Dam
scenes.context: The pier is rotten in three places. Baba Dam, the old fisherman, can't fix it alone.

lines.text: Who's that man with the glass of water? He's always carrying one. Never drinks it.
Baba Dam gave someone fish. Baba Dam! He doesn't give anybody anything. Not even time.

scenes.title: Mission 12: Licence
scenes.context: Coach Danladi says real campus life is on three wheels. Get your keke licence by winning the Hostel Run — with two passengers in the back who will not stop talking.

lines.text: Lula and Faty were in a keke screaming "write that down". Write what down?!
That couple arrives together and leaves together. Even to the toilet. Respect.

scenes.title: Mission 13: Keke Grand Prix
scenes.context: The Ring Road Grand Prix: twelve kekes, one lap of the whole campus, a trophy made of an old exhaust pipe sprayed gold. Half the campus is watching.

lines.text: Number seven stopped to help. Or lost. Depends who you ask. I'm asking Aleeya.
Yusuf talked his way onto the track. Into the pit. Into my heart. Unacceptable.

scenes.title: Mission 14: The dam at midnight
scenes.context: Baba Dam's nets come up torn every night, and something under the water hums when the lights go out. He wants to see it.

lines.text: Baba Dam was shouting at the water. The water shouted back. I'm not going there again.
Who throws kilishi into a dam? Who wastes kilishi? Criminals.

scenes.title: Mission 15: The class of your life
scenes.context: Dr. Okonkwo takes the relay core, goes quiet, then gives you a choice: she'll explain what it is — after you score four out of five in her test.

lines.text: Bature got a question right with his eyes closed. Witchcraft or revision?
lines.scene: Mission 15: The class of your life

lines.text: I studied all night. I don't remember my name. I remember Ohm's law. Priorities.
lines.scene: Mission 15: The class of your life

scenes.title: Mission 16: Gather the crew
scenes.context: The Maker says the shades will gather at the Senate on the night of the next blackout, and that one person with a torch is a snack. Five people with torches is a problem for them.

lines.text: Big Sly bought suya for John Carter. I've seen everything. I can die now.
Tunde's drawing won and he didn't even sign it. Who does that? Nice people. Suspicious.

scenes.title: Mission 17: Count Entropy
scenes.context: The blackout comes on Thursday, as the Maker said. The shades pour across the boulevard to the Senate.

lines.text: Big Sly cried. He said it was dust. It was dust. From his heart.
Who is the Count? Somebody said he looks like what we're scared of. That's worse.

scenes.title: Mission 18: Wings
scenes.context: Captain Uche has watched freshers dance at the Senate on her phone. She says anybody who can make a campus dance can learn to make a plane climb.

lines.text: I saw the plane and thought it was the Count. It was a fresher. Even scarier.
Lula waved with one leg on the market roof. Faty wrote it down. Peace on earth.

scenes.title: Mission 19: Up NEPA party
scenes.context: The light has stayed on for a whole week. DJ Kabiru says that deserves noise, and he needs a crowd, a snack table and somebody brave enough to dance first.

lines.text: I danced in the dark. Nobody saw. Best night of my life.
Who sold that generator fuel? I want his number. To report him.

scenes.title: Mission 20: Profile picture
scenes.context: Lyzzy says your profile picture is "a crime against your face". She will fix it, if you pose at four gardens before the light goes.

lines.text: Lyzzy posted you. You're famous now. Small famous. Hostel famous.
The Senate had a cape? In my photo too. I thought it was a bird.

scenes.title: Mission 21: Express delivery
scenes.context: Emeka the okada rider has sprained his wrist on the busiest morning of the month. Four deliveries, his bike, your backpack, and his phone ringing the whole time.

lines.text: Backpacks are in. Even the lecturers have them. Prof. Bello has two.
Who's building on the ridge? My grandfather said they tried that before.

scenes.title: Mission 22: Senate Sprint
scenes.context: The Senate Sprint is one lap of the Senate and back, the shortest race on campus and the dirtiest. Coach Danladi enters you.

lines.text: Did Sly stop to help? I need to lie down.
John Carter fixed a chain in eight seconds. I timed it.

scenes.title: Mission 23: The hum
scenes.context: The Maker says the ground has started humming. He wants you to listen with him, at night, when the campus is quiet enough to hear what is under it.

lines.text: The ground is humming? My stomach is humming. Different problem.
The man with the coil never sleeps. My uncle saw him in the nineties. Same coat.

scenes.title: Mission 24: Two papers, one day
scenes.context: Physics test at nine. Mathematics test at nine.

lines.text: Who is this Muktar? He made me stand in alphabetical order. I felt safe.
Yusuf finished early again. He says he guessed. Nobody guesses integration.

scenes.title: Mission 25: Paper trail
scenes.context: Mai Shayi has noticed a man in a good suit who visits the Bank after closing, every time the light goes. He would like to know why.

lines.text: The Bank had light again last night. The Bank always has light.
Corporal Peter says he was observing. With snoring. Advanced observing.

scenes.title: Mission 26: East Side Drift
scenes.context: The East Side Drift is a car race round the tightest corners on campus. Kelechi lost it last year to a senior who "drove like a poem".

lines.text: My shoes are wet. My soul is wet. The rain has entered my spirit.
Who taught the fresher to drift? It was the rain. The rain taught them.

scenes.title: Mission 27: What the net caught
scenes.context: Something in the water at the Dam took Baba Dam's net and dragged it under. Tonight the net came back, and it is full of something that is not fish.

lines.text: The Maker is gone? He's never gone. He's like the Senate. You don't lose the Senate.
My phone is back! I lost it in a blackout. It smells of fish. I love it.

scenes.title: Mission 28: Wingman
scenes.context: Sadiq likes Joy, the radio intern. Sadiq has never said more than "Toh" to her.

lines.text: Sadiq spoke to a girl? Sadiq? Speaks?
The Maker's been gone three days. Even the Love Garden is dark. Romance is suffering.

scenes.title: Mission 29: Night market
scenes.context: With the Maker gone four days and the market dark at night, a gang of older boys calling themselves "the levy" are going stall to stall, collecting a "light fee" for lamps that don't exist.

lines.text: Hajiya paid zero. Zero! She's a legend. I'm going to pay zero for everything now.
An old woman threw a slipper so hard it came back. Like a boomerang. Respect.

scenes.title: Mission 30: Signal from the sky
scenes.context: Captain Uche wants a dusk flight "for the joy of it", a loop over the campus at the golden hour. Bring a camera.

lines.text: The light came back the same minute the plane passed. Coincidence. Probably.
Bature says he flew. He's still green. He says it's his natural colour now.

scenes.title: Mission 31: The second eel
scenes.context: The thing in the water that pulled Baba Dam's net is a mother eel, very old and very large. Since the Maker's absence, the shades have been gathering on her, and she is lashing at

lines.text: Lyzzy posted the eel. Forty thousand views. The eel is more famous than me.
Baba Dam says the eel is a mother. My mother is also long and angry. Respect.

scenes.title: Mission 32: Six plaques
scenes.context: The Maker has the dynamo. To use it he needs three more things: a perfect answer, copper winding and a spark gap.

lines.text: Prof. Bello lent someone his spark gap. Prof. Bello never lends. Is the world ending?
John Carter wound a whole dynamo. I saw it. He wouldn't let me count.

scenes.title: Mission 33: School Marathon
scenes.context: The School Marathon is the whole campus on foot. Coach Danladi's prize this year is a generator, donated by the traders.

lines.text: I ran the marathon. I'm a different person now. A tired person.
Tunde drew the winner before the race. He's not allowed to draw the exam results.

scenes.title: Mission 34: Everybody
scenes.context: The Maker has a generator, a dynamo and a coil that hums. He says that on convocation night, when the seniors graduate and the whole campus lights up, the dark will come for the light.

lines.text: Everybody's going to the garden. I don't know why. I'm going.
Malam Garba left a door open. I've been here three years. That's a first.

scenes.title: Mission 35: Blackout protocol
scenes.context: Three nights before convocation, the whole grid fails. Sgt.

lines.text: The radio stopped and I heard the silence. Never again. Talk forever, Kabiru.
Madam Whistle whistled at a shade. The shade left. Respect.

scenes.title: Mission 36: Convocation night
scenes.context: Convocation night. The seniors graduate; every light on campus goes on at once; and Count Entropy, fully grown on a year of the school's fear, stands on the Senate steps.

lines.text: I graduated and a fresher stole my night. Best night of my life.
Did you see the cape on the weathervane? After? …No? Good. Me neither.

scenes.title: Mission 37: Stalite
scenes.context: You come back from the break and somebody else's name is on your bed. Sort it out before dark, and find out what "stalite" means.

lines.text: Second year. I'm practically a lecturer.

scenes.title: Mission 38: Grand opening
scenes.context: The market is now a mall. Hajiya Ladi's goods are at the gate, her new shop is upstairs, and the only escalator goes up.

lines.text: I came to buy pepper and I'm leaving with a phone case.
Where is the suya man? What have they done with the suya man?
Faaa! The escalator stopped and I kept walking.

scenes.title: Mission 39: New drip
scenes.context: Alhaji Needle will sew your first native. It will be ready Thursday.

lines.text: Is that new? It's new. Turn round.

scenes.title: Mission 40: Level two, round one
scenes.context: Basit holds every high score in the Game Room. He lets you pick the machine.

lines.text: He has not left that machine since the mall opened.
My brother beat him once. He was six. Basit did not speak for a week.

scenes.title: Mission 41: The mall never blinks
scenes.context: The whole campus goes dark at once. Across the road the mall is glowing like a ship.

lines.text: The mall has light. The mall always has light.

scenes.title: Mission 42: Meter reader
scenes.context: Every evening, just before the campus goes dark, a Works van leaves the substation and drives to the mall. Follow it without being seen.

lines.text: Light just went. I was in the middle of ironing.

scenes.title: Mission 43: Department week
scenes.context: Your first department week: a quiz against the department next door, a five-a-side, and a dinner with a dress code and a speech.

lines.text: Their HOD spoke for forty minutes. The jollof had gone cold with respect.
Lula-and-Faty, which one of you laughed during the speech?

scenes.title: Mission 44: Iron Mama hums
scenes.context: The Maker has listened to the ground for a year. He sends you where he cannot go: under the mall, after closing, to see what is making the hum.

lines.text: You look like you didn't sleep. Was it reading or was it wahala?

scenes.title: Mission 45: Shuttle strike
scenes.context: The shuttle drivers have parked over unpaid allowances. Phase 2 is four kilometres away and full of stranded students.

lines.text: I walked it. I am a different person now.

scenes.title: Mission 46: Sly goes straight
scenes.context: Bolaji is opening a barber's chair in the mall. His old court boys think that is the funniest thing they have heard.

lines.text: He did my hairline. I have never been so afraid and so satisfied.

scenes.title: Mission 47: Test week
scenes.context: Three tests in two days, Ada's night tutorial under the one working lamp, a summons from the HOD you were not expecting, and then first-semester exams in NELT.

lines.text: Three tests. Two days. One brain.
Somebody snitched? On who? Tell me everything. Slowly.

scenes.title: Mission 48: Flying lesson two
scenes.context: Captain Uche wants your turns tidier. You want a photograph of the mall roof.

lines.text: Somebody was flying very low today. Looking for what?

scenes.title: Mission 49: Chief Megawatt
scenes.context: The mall's owner invites you up. He would like to sponsor your department.

lines.text: He gave our hall a water tank. With his face on it.

scenes.title: Mission 50: Bolaji's board
scenes.context: A skate contest in the mall car park. Bolaji, all six feet of him, needs a spotter, somebody to film, and somebody to believe it.

lines.text: The security man clapped. Then remembered he is security.
E choke! How is somebody that big that light on a board?

scenes.title: Mission 51: Change-Over
scenes.context: You know the driver's name now. He sees you coming and runs, through the market, on an okada.

lines.text: Somebody rode through the market like the devil was collecting rent.

scenes.title: Mission 52: Phase 2 goes dark
scenes.context: While the feeder is argued over, Phase 2 has had no light for a week. Water, torches and charged phones go out in convoy on the long road at night.

lines.text: They came at midnight with water. I will name a child after that keke.

scenes.title: Mission 53: The second coil
scenes.context: The Maker reads the second plaque aloud. The coil under the mall needs three parts.

lines.text: The MIB Store gave somebody a discount. I don't believe it. I want names.

scenes.title: Mission 54: Love in the time of NEPA
scenes.context: A plan for the evening. Then no light, and no money either.

lines.text: Garri has never left me. I can't say the same for people.
lines.scene: Mission 54: Love in the time of NEPA

scenes.title: Mission 56: Light for everybody
scenes.context: The feeder must be switched back at three corners of campus, ninety seconds apart. Then a panel in the Senate asks what you saw, and reads your own choices back to you.

lines.text: The shuttle men have been paid. Baba Shuttle hooted for one full minute.

scenes.title: Mission 58: Three hundred
scenes.context: Third year. The notice board puts you in a project group of four: two serious, one asleep in Pepsi Garden, one not seen since Tuesday.

lines.text: Group of four. I am doing the work of five.

scenes.title: Mission 66: Old Campus
scenes.context: Walls with trees growing through them. A plaque with the same marks as Kelechi's statues.

lines.text: Somebody was playing an old woman's voice in the speaker shop. I got goose pimples.
lines.tone: A passer-by (at the mall): overheard in passing

scenes.title: Mission 70: Called off
scenes.context: The strike is over. The buses come back all at once, and Kabiru has hidden a treasure hunt across campus to welcome everybody.

lines.text: Fourteen weeks of lectures in seven. Lunch is now theoretical.

scenes.title: Mission 71: Bolaji's choice
scenes.context: The mall wants Bolaji skating in its adverts full-time. He has a withdrawal form half filled in.

lines.text: Bolaji with a form? I thought he was allergic to paper.

scenes.title: Mission 72: Workshop nights
scenes.context: Group Light Work's project: solar lamps for the dark road to Phase 2. Dr.

lines.text: Mr. Ezekiel smiled. I have a witness.

scenes.title: Mission 73: Test run
scenes.context: The first lamp goes up at dusk on the darkest bend. It comes on.

lines.text: I walked past it twice just to be seen by it.
lines.tone: A passer-by (P2 student): overheard in passing

scenes.title: Mission 79: IT letter
scenes.context: One letter, four stamps, three offices, two "come back tomorrow"s and a bank queue. Then a choice of where you train for six months.

lines.text: I have been in this queue since I was a fresher.

scenes.title: Mission 80: First day at work
scenes.context: Your supervisor hands you a broom. Then a clipboard.

lines.text: The last IT student broke the kettle. We don't speak of it.
lines.tone: A passer-by (a colleague): overheard in passing

scenes.title: Mission 81: Lucky goes viral
scenes.context: Somebody filmed your dance at The Floor and put a beat under it. By lunch the whole school has seen it, and a brand wants your feet.

lines.text: IS THAT YOU? Mum has watched it eleven times. Send more.
lines.tone: little sibling on the phone: on the phone

scenes.title: Mission 82: The collab
scenes.context: Lucky wants three stunts for one video: a wheelie down the boulevard, a wave from the Senate steps, a keke full of goats. Then you go to buy socks and forty people want a picture.

lines.text: I touched their sleeve. I'm not washing this hand.

scenes.title: Mission 83: Echo
scenes.context: Mai Shayi says you were rude to him last night. You were asleep last night.

lines.text: I greeted you yesterday and you looked through me. Was that you?

scenes.title: Mission 84: Workplace accident
scenes.context: A colleague is down. Stop the bleeding, keep them talking, drive to the Sick Bay gently.

lines.text: Okonkwo went to somebody's IT place without warning. Pray for them.

scenes.title: Mission 86: Hock Day (the time loop)
scenes.context: Your roommate's birthday at the buka and Lucky's rooftop party fall on the same day. Then the day starts again.

lines.text: Hot today, abi? …Hot today, abi? Why are you laughing?
Déjà vu, my brother. Déjà vu.

scenes.title: Mission 87: Night flight (Heist 3: the old control tower)
scenes.context: The old control tower has been locked since before Captain Uche. The fourth plaque is inside, the stairs are full of Echoes, and the beacon must be lined up from the air on three passes.

lines.text: The old tower had a light on last night. My grandfather says that never happens.
lines.scene: Mission 87: Night flight (Heist 3: the old control tower)

scenes.title: Mission 88: Fashion show
scenes.context: Alhaji Needle's collection on a runway through the mall. He needs a model who can walk and turn.

lines.text: Needle and the MIB woman are not speaking. They are both smiling. It is terrifying.

scenes.title: Mission 91: The real clip
scenes.context: Somebody's phone caught the real thing and fell in the fountain. Chi-Tech can save it for three favours.

lines.text: So there were two of them? I KNEW the dancing one was too nice.

scenes.title: Mission 92: Double booking
scenes.context: Two people were promised the same evening. If it was you, face it.

lines.text: They split the bill between themselves and left him with the bones.

scenes.title: Mission 93: Cook-off
scenes.context: The food court is half the price and the buka is half empty. She will not ask for help.

lines.text: Garri deluxe. With milk. And ice. I have seen the future.

scenes.title: Mission 94: Election day
scenes.context: Comrade Sadiya is running again and Yakubu is her manager. Posters, a debate card that says "second speaker", and a ballot box that turns out to be under the returning officer's chair.

lines.text: I voted. Then I voted for best jollof. That one mattered.

scenes.title: Mission 101: The Maker's notebook
scenes.context: Choose a supervisor for your final-year project. Then the Maker gives you the book he has never shown anyone, half of it in a shorthand only your class could read.

lines.text: Somebody's project is a whole Tesla coil. Mine is a questionnaire.

scenes.title: Mission 102: Fresher tax, reversed
scenes.context: A new boy at the court is taxing freshers. Big Sly would like a word with him.

lines.text: The big barber gave me ₦50 extra. I don't know why. I'm keeping it.

scenes.title: Mission 103: Sixth site (Heist 2: the Senate basement)
scenes.context: The sixth plaque says only "at the centre". One reference is in a room the library does not admit to having, four corners of campus have to be measured, and the centre turns out to be a room

lines.text: A room under the Senate? I thought that's where they kept the come-back-tomorrows.
lines.scene: Mission 103: Sixth site (Heist 2: the Senate basement)

scenes.title: Mission 104: Megawatt's offer
scenes.context: The coil costs more than a keke. Raise it honestly, or let Chief Megawatt pay for all of it and put his name on the tower.

lines.text: I gave ₦100. I want my name on one screw.

scenes.title: Mission 106: Build week
scenes.context: Frame. Two thousand turns of copper.

lines.text: I heard it worked for three seconds. That's three more than mine.

scenes.title: Mission 109: The Chancellor's shadow
scenes.context: A letter on every board: "Convocation is cancelled." No signature. The paper is cold.

lines.text: Cancelled? After five years? I'll convocate myself in my room if I have to.

scenes.title: Mission 117: Gown
scenes.context: A name on a board, a gown from the mall, and five photographs in five places with whoever mattered most there.

lines.text: Wear the cap straight. Mum says. I say tilt it.
lines.tone: little sibling on the phone: on the phone

scenes.title: Side mission 1: Sadiq's pot
scenes.context: His mother's soup needs six things from the market, and the pot nobody will admit to borrowing.

lines.text: Who is cooking egusi in a boys' hostel? I'm coming with my plate.

scenes.title: Side mission 3: Firdausi's radio
scenes.context: Her radio gets one station and it is the wrong one. Fix it without Mr.

lines.text: Who fixed Firdausi's radio? It plays three stations and a hum. Fancy.

scenes.title: Side mission 4: Ada's timetable
scenes.context: She has colour-coded your week. Follow it for one day.

lines.text: Why is your timetable rainbow? Are you okay?

scenes.title: Side mission 5: Ada's fees
scenes.context: A deadline, a queue, and a quiet favour from Dr. Khadija that Ada must never hear about.

lines.text: The bursary smiled at me today. I'm scared.

scenes.title: Side mission 6: Yakubu's attendance sheet
scenes.context: The sheet is missing and the lecturer wants it by four. Forty signatures in forty places.

lines.text: Sign? Bring it up. I'm not coming down. The mangoes know me.
lines.tone: A Student: up a mango tree

lines.text: Normalise sleeping in class. …Where do I sign?
Did someone just make me sign for a class I'm not in? I signed. Solidarity.
Did that goat just sign the attendance sheet? Na wa o.

scenes.title: Side mission 9: Fatima speaks
scenes.context: She has to give a five-minute talk. Be her audience six times in six places.

lines.text: Fatima gave a talk and Bolaji clapped. The windows are still shaking.

scenes.title: Side mission 11: Bolaji's scripts
scenes.context: You find his exam scripts in his skate bag. All As.

lines.text: Big Sly taught me calculus. He said if I tell anyone, he'll teach me more.

scenes.title: Side mission 12: Kelechi's clay
scenes.context: The good clay is at the Dam's edge. So are the goats.

lines.text: Why are those goats following you? Do you owe them money?

scenes.title: Side mission 13: The eighth statue
scenes.context: Someone painted a moustache on the unsigned statue. Kelechi is far too upset for a stranger's work.

lines.text: It was a dare. I'm sorry. I'll clean it.
(a week later) I'm doing sculpture as an elective now. He made me. I'm happy.
The statue's moustache is gone. I liked it. It had personality.

scenes.title: Side mission 14: Emeka's keke
scenes.context: He has saved for two years. Go with him to buy it and stop him paying the first price.

lines.text: That rust is vintage. That rust has a story. …Okay. ₦520,000.
That keke is named after somebody's mother. You can tell. It drives respectfully.
Emeka is charging ₦50 and giving free advice. Cheap ride, expensive advice.

scenes.title: Side mission 17: Joy's night show
scenes.context: The anonymous host has lost her voice. Read the dedications.

lines.text: Play something for the girl who sits by the window in NELT. She knows.
(next day) Did you hear the Calm Voice last night? She sounded like a guy. Still calm.
The girl by the window in NELT is smiling today. Mystery solved.
Who read the dedications last night? They sounded scared. I loved it.

scenes.title: Side mission 18: AB's checklist
scenes.context: He wants to rehearse his flight test on the ground, on bicycles, with arm signals.

lines.text: Why are those people cycling in a square and saluting? Main character energy.
Why is AB flapping his arms on a bicycle? Is that a new dance?

scenes.title: Side mission 20: Basit's sister
scenes.context: He works two jobs. Cover one shift so he can make his sister Jasmin's visiting day.

lines.text: He used a cheat! - ANOTHER: It's called skill! - PLAYER: It's called "both of you out".
Mister, the machine ate my token. Mister, the machine is hungry. Feed it again.

scenes.title: Side mission 21: Basit loses
scenes.context: He has lost to a child. Console him.

lines.text: Again? Okay. (She wins without looking.) Can I go home now? My mother said six.
(Year 4) Coach Basit says I need to look at the screen sometimes. I don't.

scenes.title: Side mission 22: Maryam's noticeboard
scenes.context: Someone keeps pasting stories on the boards. She asks you to help catch the author.

lines.text: New story on the Senate board! It's about a goat that wanted to be a professor!
New story on the board! It's about yam! Who's writing these?

scenes.title: Side mission 23: Maryam's reading
scenes.context: Her first public reading. Fill twelve chairs.

lines.text: A reading? Is there food? …Yam? I'm coming. I'll clap at the right places.

scenes.title: Side mission 24: Micheal's audition
scenes.context: The Drama Club needs a second actor for one scene. You have six lines and a fake beard.

lines.text: The Generator That Wept? I cried. NEPA made me cry first.
The beard was the best actor in the play. No cap.
The man whose beard fell off? Genius. I'm going again tomorrow.

scenes.title: Side mission 25: Lucky's first video
scenes.context: Before the followers, his "day in the life" video has nothing happening in it.

lines.text: Have you seen the goat video? The goat has more followers than Lucky.
Have you seen Lucky's goat video? The goat has more followers than me.

scenes.title: Side mission 27: Mai Shayi's kettle
scenes.context: The kettle has a hole. Bright Electricals cannot help.

lines.text: Mai Shayi's tea is sweeter since the kettle got fixed. Science.

scenes.title: Side mission 28: Hajiya's ledger
scenes.context: Three students owe nothing because somebody always pays. Deliver three receipts and say nothing.

lines.text: Paid? By who? - PLAYER: I'm just the delivery.
Is this a scam? It's a scam. …It's not a scam? Sapa has left the chat.
(crying) I was going to go home. I was packing.
(Year 5, passing the stall) Hajiya, I'm graduating. I know it was you. Last price: thanks.
Somebody paid my debt at Hajiya's. Whoever you are, God bless your garri.

scenes.title: Side mission 29: Baba Dam's net
scenes.context: Mend a net with him. He tells one riddle per knot.

lines.text: Old man by the Dam talks to the water. The water answers. I've heard it.
Baba Dam is teaching riddles now? I'm going to fish for answers.

scenes.title: Side mission 30: Nurse Hauwa's list
scenes.context: Check on four students from her list, as if by accident.

lines.text: I'm fine. I'm— is that suya? I'm not fine. Thank you.
A riddle? From Bature? …That's terrible.
lines.tone: Student 2: laughs for the first time in a week

lines.text: Walk? To where? …Anywhere. Okay. The pier.
Call my mother? She'll cry. …Okay. Hold the phone. I can't.
(weeks later, at the pier) I come here now. Alone. It's good alone now. Thank you.

scenes.title: Side mission 32: Coach Danladi's speech
scenes.context: He must give a prize-giving speech without shouting or crying. Rehearse him.

lines.text: Coach cried. He said it was dust. It's rainy season.
The coach cried and won Best Speech. The other coach shouted and lost.
Coach said four words and the whole club cried. Even the bikes.

scenes.title: Side mission 33: Kabiru off air
scenes.context: The studio mic is dead and he must MC a wedding in person. He is terrified.

lines.text: Who was that MC? Can he do my sister's wedding? He was so… radio.
Hold your plates, here comes love. Who said that? I'm using it at my wedding.

scenes.title: Side mission 34: Madam Whistle's sprint
scenes.context: A goat snatches a trader's bag. Sgt.

lines.text: Madam Whistle caught a goat with one hand. With ONE hand.

scenes.title: Side mission 35: Oga Pee's shortcuts
scenes.context: He trades five shortcuts for five sticks of suya.

lines.text: Oga Pee knows a shortcut to the canteen? Through the kitchen? Allowed?

scenes.title: Side mission 37: Mr. Ezekiel's shelf
scenes.context: Every "condemned" instrument in the lab works. Help him carry one home and one back.

lines.text: Another "condemned" machine? This one plays the radio better than ours.
Mr. Ezekiel's wife waved at me with an oscilloscope. Campus is weird.
The lab ghost fixed my oscilloscope. I'm leaving it a biscuit.

scenes.title: Side mission 39: Dr. Okonkwo's class photo
scenes.context: An old photograph: a class in front of the coil. One face is very familiar.

lines.text: Dr. Okonkwo keeps a photo face-down. Nobody asks. Everyone wonders.
lines.scene: Side mission 39: Dr. Okonkwo's class photo

scenes.title: Side mission 40: Aunty Asiya's supper
scenes.context: Take the Maker's food tonight; she has stocktake. He asks what the mall is like.

lines.text: The Maker ate on the bench and stared at the coil for an hour. Normal?

scenes.title: Side mission 41: Needle's Thursday
scenes.context: It is ready. It is the wrong colour.

lines.text: Who did this to you? …In a good way. Who is your tailor?

scenes.title: Side mission 42: Chi-Tech's photos
scenes.context: A cracked phone with a stranger's family pictures. Find the owner from three clues.

lines.text: That dog? That's Professor. He lives behind Akenzua. He belongs to everybody.
Chi-Tech found a family through a dog with one ear. Detective things.
(at the market) My phone has my husband again. Come, take a free orange.

scenes.title: Side mission 43: Sugar's accounts
scenes.context: She has an accounting test tomorrow and a full floor tonight. Run the decks for one set.

lines.text: Faaa! (a dropped beat) … Waaa!
The DJ is an accountant? So that's why the bass is balanced.
Sugar did accounting AND a set? God when?
The DJ pressed the red button and the floor went crazy. Again!

scenes.title: Side mission 44: Baba Shuttle's last trip
scenes.context: His bus is being retired. Ride the full route with him and name the regulars.

lines.text: Baba Shuttle drove my wedding. My children's school. Now me. Shift for the man.
lines.scene: Side mission 44: Baba Shuttle's last trip

lines.text: The new bus says "Baba Linus" on the side. It drives slower. Out of respect.
lines.scene: Side mission 44: Baba Shuttle's last trip

lines.text: Baba Shuttle walks the route now. He still says "next stop" to nobody.
lines.scene: Side mission 44: Baba Shuttle's last trip

lines.text: The sleeping woman woke at her stop on the new bus too. Legend.
lines.scene: Side mission 44: Baba Shuttle's last trip

lines.text: The old bus is gone. The new one is quiet. I miss the noise.
lines.scene: Side mission 44: Baba Shuttle's last trip

scenes.title: Side mission 46: Clean-up Saturday
scenes.context: Both fellowships clean the Dam shore together. Fill ten sacks.

Group of four. I am doing the work of five.

The Generator That Wept? I cried. NEPA made me cry first.

Have you seen the goat video? The goat has more followers than Lucky.
Have you seen Lucky's goat video? The goat has more followers than me.
Mai Shayi's tea is sweeter since the kettle got fixed. Science.
Paid? By who? - PLAYER: I'm just the delivery.
Is this a scam? It's a scam. …It's not a scam? Sapa has left the chat.
(crying) I was going to go home. I was packing.
(Year 5, passing the stall) Hajiya, I'm graduating. I know it was you. Last price: thanks.
Somebody paid my debt at Hajiya's. Whoever you are, God bless your garri.
Old man by the Dam talks to the water. The water answers. I've heard it.
Baba Dam is teaching riddles now? I'm going to fish for answers.
I'm fine. I'm— is that suya? I'm not fine. Thank you.
A riddle? From Bature? …That's terrible.

lines.text: Walk? To where? …Anywhere. Okay. The pier.
Call my mother? She'll cry. …Okay. Hold the phone. I can't.
(weeks later, at the pier) I come here now. Alone. It's good alone now. Thank you.
Coach cried. He said it was dust. It's rainy season.
The coach cried and won Best Speech. The other coach shouted and lost.
Coach said four words and the whole club cried. Even the bikes.
Who was that MC? Can he do my sister's wedding? He was so… radio.
Hold your plates, here comes love. Who said that? I'm using it at my wedding.
Madam Whistle caught a goat with one hand. With ONE hand.
Oga Pee knows a shortcut to the canteen? Through the kitchen? Allowed?
Another "condemned" machine? This one plays the radio better than ours.
Mr. Ezekiel's wife waved at me with an oscilloscope. Campus is weird.
The lab ghost fixed my oscilloscope. I'm leaving it a biscuit.
Dr. Okonkwo keeps a photo face-down. Nobody asks. Everyone wonders.

lines.text: The Maker ate on the bench and stared at the coil for an hour. Normal?
Who did this to you? …In a good way. Who is your tailor?
That dog? That's Professor. He lives behind Akenzua. He belongs to everybody.
Chi-Tech found a family through a dog with one ear. Detective things.
(at the market) My phone has my husband again. Come, take a free orange.
Faaa! (a dropped beat) … Waaa!
The DJ is an accountant? So that's why the bass is balanced.
Sugar did accounting AND a set? God when?
The DJ pressed the red button and the floor went crazy. Again!
Baba Shuttle drove my wedding. My children's school. Now me. Shift for the man.

lines.scene: Side mission 44: Baba Shuttle's last trip

Both fellowships played football and nobody fought. God when? Today!
Air! Real air! Emotional healing!
Read the last line again. The one about the goat. My mother is so funny.
The Sick Bay fan stopped clicking. The ward is too quiet. Who did this?
The fan doesn't click any more. I can't sleep without it. Bring it back.
The union president failed a course? And passed the resit? She's one of us.
Vote for honesty and integrals. Strange slogan. Strong slogan.
Comrade Sadiya said she failed? Respect. She's getting my vote.
Are those my socks? Give them back after.
Jega's socks have their own fan page now.
(later) Uncle Sadiq said follow you. You said follow me. I'm following both.
(a week later) I know the way now. Follow me. No, the other way.
Gently. Like you're asking, not taking.

lines.text: MIB Strawberries? Original? God when?

lines.text: Why does that girl only appear on Wednesdays? Is it a church thing?
There's a horse in the canteen queue. She's ahead of me. She has better manners.
A horse ate my orange and looked at me like I owed her another.
The mare's back. She brought an orange peel as a souvenir.
Bature and Tanko are arguing about a horse's name again. Day 1,800.
Why is there half a tower? - ANOTHER: Sapa. The tower has sapa.
Ten floors. One built. Nine dreams. Bring wood.
Second Chance keke took me to Phase 2 for ₦100. Smooth. Emotional.
Who cut Big Sly's hair? He looks like a mechanic in a magazine.
lines.scene: Side mission 58: Bolaji & Big Baby: the haircut

lines.text: The hall tap works! Muktar is crying at a tap!
KB raised the price of candles. Should I worry? …I'm buying candles.
Why is there a riddle on the bench? "What is warm and has no fire?" The bench, obviously.
There's a paper slip under the coiled serpent statue. It says "later".
Why is everyone reading little papers by the statues? Is it exams?
They fixed my bike AND my homesickness. ₦500 total. Inside life.
I went to fix my bike and left with my feelings fixed. Same price.
The repair clinic fixed my phone AND my mood. Five stars.
The pretty one is FUNNY? Who did this to us?
Aleeya is funny? Like, FUNNY funny? Emotional damage to my assumptions.
If I have seen further, it is by standing on the shoulders of giants.

roles.label: The Maker
roles.who: Muhammad Iliyasu Bugaje himself. The owner records this one.
roles.sound: The Maker, keeper of the Tesla coil: calm, dry, kind and exact, a man showing visitors round something he built. When he quotes Rumi, slow down and let the old words land. Use your own natural voice and your normal Nigerian English. Speak Pidgin, Hausa, Yoruba or Igbo exactly where it is written. Do not put on a voice or an accent.

scenes.title: Mission 6: Mai Shayi knows
scenes.context: Mai Shayi Audu knows every rumour on campus and sells it with tea. He says the shades gather in the Sculpture Garden.

lines.text: You brought tea. Audu sent you. He always sends the polite ones.
A man who was a student here. Then a teacher. Then neither. Sit. Not on the bench.
It's warm. It's always warm. Some things should be left to stay that way.
Thank you. Let me see the book Abbas gave you. …Page forty. Of course.
Six circles. Six places the light was meant to be held. One day, perhaps.
Not tonight. Tonight, drink your tea before it learns to be cold.

scenes.title: Mission 11: Baba Dam
scenes.context: The pier is rotten in three places. Baba Dam, the old fisherman, can't fix it alone.

lines.text: My sister used to feed the fish here.
She said they knew her footsteps. Perhaps they did.
Tell Baba the planks are good.
lines.tone: The Maker: after a long pause

scenes.title: Mission 16: Gather the crew
scenes.context: The Maker says the shades will gather at the Senate on the night of the next blackout, and that one person with a torch is a snack. Five people with torches is a problem for them.

lines.text: Thursday night there will be no light. They'll come for the Senate.
Alone, you're a snack. With friends, you're a meal they can't finish.
Five. And one good joke. Go.

scenes.title: Mission 17: Count Entropy
scenes.context: The blackout comes on Thursday, as the Maker said. The shades pour across the boulevard to the Senate.

lines.text: That was not the end of him. That was the end of his first face.
Go and dance. Fear has a short memory. Joy has a longer one. Use it.

scenes.title: Mission 23: The hum
scenes.context: The Maker says the ground has started humming. He wants you to listen with him, at night, when the campus is quiet enough to hear what is under it.

lines.text: You came. Good. Do you hear it?
Under the coil. Come back tonight. Bring someone who listens.
Don't chase them. Push them back. They only want the dark.
Something is drinking from the same well. I don't know what. Yet.
That is mine. From long ago. They were guarding it. Or keeping it from me.
Go and sleep. The ground will still be humming tomorrow. So will I.

scenes.title: Mission 30: Signal from the sky
scenes.context: Captain Uche wants a dusk flight "for the joy of it", a loop over the campus at the golden hour. Bring a camera.

lines.text: You're out of breath. Sit down.
Here. Mostly. Did the market hold? Good. Sit.
A ring. Yes. Somebody drew that once. A long time ago.
Go. Eat. Asiya's plate is empty because I ate it. Don't tell her I said so.

scenes.title: Mission 31: The second eel
scenes.context: The thing in the water that pulled Baba Dam's net is a mother eel, very old and very large. Since the Maker's absence, the shades have been gathering on her, and she is lashing at

lines.text: Mine. From before. I dropped it in the water thirty years ago. On purpose.
So nobody would use it without me. The eel kept my promise better than I did.
Someone I knew used to say the eel was the Dam's guard. I laughed. They were right.
Go and sleep. You've been in the water. You smell like it.

scenes.title: Mission 32: Six plaques
scenes.context: The Maker has the dynamo. To use it he needs three more things: a perfect answer, copper winding and a spark gap.

lines.text: The dynamo works. The coil doesn't, with it. It needs three things.
An answer. Copper. A gap for the spark to jump. In that order.
Where the first light was kept. That's here.
Beneath the market, where people gather.
The first laboratory. Where the sky is watched. Where the water is held.
At the centre.
Somebody did. Several somebodies. It didn't work. Then it did, a little. Here.
You'll want to know what it's for. Light. That's all. It's always just light.
Neither do I. Put the plate back.
One. Lit, a little. The others are dark. They've been dark a long time.
You're a first year.

scenes.title: Mission 34: Everybody
scenes.context: The Maker has a generator, a dynamo and a coil that hums. He says that on convocation night, when the seniors graduate and the whole campus lights up, the dark will come for the light.

lines.text: Convocation night. Every light on campus, all at once. The dark notices that.
I can't hold it alone. I tried. For a long time. Ask everybody.
Everybody you've helped. You'll find it's more than you think.
I said everybody. I didn't believe it. Hm. Sit. Eat Mama Nkechi's food.

scenes.title: Mission 36: Convocation night
scenes.context: Convocation night. The seniors graduate; every light on campus goes on at once; and Count Entropy, fully grown on a year of the school's fear, stands on the Senate steps.

lines.text: Tonight we start the resonator. It will take a while to sing. Keep them off it.
When it sings, the light goes where it's needed. Follow it.
There. It's found him. Follow the light. Go!
…Thank you.
One. That's one. There were meant to be six.
You're still a first year.
…No. Not for long. Go and sleep. I'll keep it on. For tonight.

scenes.title: Mission 44: Iron Mama hums
scenes.context: The Maker has listened to the ground for a year. He sends you where he cannot go: under the mall, after closing, to see what is making the hum.

lines.text: Two. Yes. There are six plaques. You have only been reading the first.
I cannot leave this fence. You can. Go and look. Only look.
Walking.

scenes.title: Mission 53: The second coil
scenes.context: The Maker reads the second plaque aloud. The coil under the mall needs three parts.

lines.text: Two: beneath the market, where people gather. She liked people.
Her methodology was incontrovertibly, perspicaciously communitarian.
She liked people. Find feeder markers one and three. Then three parts.

scenes.title: Mission 63: Empty halls
scenes.context: Something is sitting in Kainji Theatre. Row after row of it.
